1.12.17.m: Then [the sacrificer's wife] sits down behind the gārhapatya fire [with the mantra]: "With good offspring may we, / with good husbands, sit down by you, / O Agni, destroyer of rivals, / unbeguiled by the unbeguiled. / Like Indrāṇī, may I not be a widow; like Aditi, may I have good sons; / unhobbled by you, O gārhapatya fire, may I sit down here for good offspring. / My sons are slayers of enemies, / and my daughter is an empress;

1.12.17.s: utāham asmi saṃjayā patyur me śloka uttamas | iti athaināṃ vācayatyūne 'tiriktaṃ dhīyātā iti ca
1.12.17.d: उताहम् अस्मि संजया पत्युर् मे श्लोक उत्तमस् । इति अथैनां वाचयत्यूने ऽतिरिक्तं धीयाता इति च
1.12.17.m: and I am victorious; / high is the fame of my husband." / [And he makes her recite: "Let what is lacking be supplied in excess."]

1.12.18.s: athaināṃ gārhapatyam īkṣayati | agne gṛhapata upa mā hvayasva devānāṃ patnīr upa mā hvayadhvam | patni patny eṣa te lokas | namas te astu mā mā him̐sīs | iti |
1.12.18.d: अथैनां गार्हपत्यम् ईक्षयति । अग्ने गृहपत उप मा ह्वयस्व देवानां पत्नीर् उप मा ह्वयध्वम् । पत्नि पत्न्य् एष ते लोकस् । नमस् ते अस्तु मा मा हिँसीस् । इति ।
1.12.18.m: Then he makes her look at the gārhapatya fire [with]: "O Agni, lord of the house, invite me; O wives of the gods, invite me. / O wife, O wife, this is your place. / Homage be to you; do not injure me."

1.12.18.s: athainām ājyam avekṣayati mahīnāṃ payo 'sy oṣadhīnām̐ rasas | adabdhena tvā cakṣuṣāvekṣe suprajāstvāya | iti |
1.12.18.d: अथैनाम् आज्यम् अवेक्षयति महीनां पयो ऽस्य् ओषधीनाँ रसस् । अदब्धेन त्वा चक्षुषावेक्षे सुप्रजास्त्वाय । इति ।
1.12.18.m: Then he makes her look at the clarified butter [with]: "You are the milk of the great ones, the sap of plants. / With an uninjured eye I look at you for the sake of having good offspring."

1.12.18.d: अथैनद् गार्हपत्ये ऽधिश्रयति तेजो ऽसि । इति
1.12.18.m: Then he places it over the gārhapatya fire [with]: "You are brilliance."

1.12.18.s: samidham upayatya prāṅ harati tejo 'nu prehi | iti | athainad āhavanīye 'dhiśrayati | agnis te tejo mā vinait | iti |
1.12.18.d: समिधम् उपयत्य प्राङ् हरति तेजो ऽनु प्रेहि । इति । अथैनद् आहवनीये ऽधिश्रयति । अग्निस् ते तेजो मा विनैत् । इति ।
1.12.18.m: Taking a kindling stick, he carries it eastwards [with]: "Go after the brilliance." / Then he places it over the āhavanīya fire [with]: "May Agni not take away your brilliance."

1.12.18.s: atraitām̐ samidhaṃ madhyata āhavanīyasyābhyādadhāti svāhā | iti
1.12.18.d: अत्रैताँ समिधं मध्यत आहवनीयस्याभ्यादधाति स्वाहा । इति
1.12.18.m: Then he puts this kindling stick onto the middle of the āhavanīya fire [with: "Svāhā"].

1.12.18.s: athainad agreṇa prokṣaṇīḥ paryāhṛtya dakṣiṇārdhe vedyai nidhāya yajamānam ājyam avekṣayati nimīlyāvekṣeta | iti brāhmaṇam
1.12.18.d: अथैनद् अग्रेण प्रोक्षणीः पर्याहृत्य दक्षिणार्धे वेद्यै निधाय यजमानम् आज्यम् अवेक्षयति निमील्यावेक्षेत । इति ब्राह्मणम्
1.12.18.m: Then, having carried it around in front of the sprinkling waters and having placed it down on the southern half of the altar, he makes the sacrificer look at the clarified butter. "He should look at it, winking"—so says the brāhmaṇa passage.

1.12.18.s: athainad yathāhṛtaṃ pratiparyāhṛtyottarārdhe vedyai nidhāyādhvaryur avekṣate | agner jihvāsi subhūr devānām | dhāmnedhāmne devebhyo yajuṣeyajuṣe bhava | iti |
1.12.18.d: अथैनद् यथाहृतं प्रतिपर्याहृत्योत्तरार्धे वेद्यै निधायाध्वर्युर् अवेक्षते । अग्नेर् जिह्वासि सुभूर् देवानाम् । धाम्नेधाम्ने देवेभ्यो यजुषेयजुषे भव । इति ।
1.12.18.m: Then, having carried it back the way it was brought and having placed it down on the northern half of the altar, the adhvaryu priest looks at it [with]: "You are Agni's tongue, the well-formed one of the gods; / become [fit] for each domain for the gods, for each sacrificial formula."

1.12.18.s: athainad udīcīnāgrābhyāṃ pavitrābhyāṃ punarāhāraṃ trir utpunāti śukram asi jyotir asi tejo 'si | iti |
1.12.18.d: अथैनद् उदीचीनाग्राभ्यां पवित्राभ्यां पुनराहारं त्रिर् उत्पुनाति शुक्रम् असि ज्योतिर् असि तेजो ऽसि । इति ।
1.12.18.m: Then, with two purifiers pointing northward, repeatedly bringing them back, he purifies it three times [with]: "You are bright, you are light, you are brilliance."

1.12.18.s: atha prokṣaṇīr utpunāti devo vaḥ savitotpunātv acchidreṇa pavitreṇa vasoḥ sūryasya raśmibhis | iti pacchaḥ
1.12.18.d: अथ प्रोक्षणीर् उत्पुनाति देवो वः सवितोत्पुनात्व् अच्छिद्रेण पवित्रेण वसोः सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिस् । इति पच्छः
1.12.18.m: Then he purifies the sprinkling waters pāda by pāda [with]: "May the divine Savitar purify you with an uninjured purifier, with the rays of the good sun."

1.12.18.s: prokṣaṇīṣu pavitre avadhāyādatte dakṣiṇena sruvaṃ savyena juhūṃ vede pratiṣṭhāpya tasyāṃ gṛhṇīte śukraṃ tvā śukrāyāṃ dhāmnedhāmne devebhyo yajuṣeyajuṣe gṛhṇāmi | ity etena yajuṣā caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā saṃmṛśyotprayacchati |
1.12.18.d: प्रोक्षणीषु पवित्रे अवधायादत्ते दक्षिणेन स्रुवं सव्येन जुहूं वेदे प्रतिष्ठाप्य तस्यां गृह्णीते शुक्रं त्वा शुक्रायां धाम्नेधाम्ने देवेभ्यो यजुषेयजुषे गृह्णामि । इत्य् एतेन यजुषा चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वा संमृश्योत्प्रयच्छति ।
1.12.18.m: Having placed the two purifiers in the sprinkling waters, taking the sruva ladle with his right hand and the juhū ladle with his left hand, and having set [the vessel] on the broom, he ladles into it with this formula: "I ladle you, bright one, into the bright [ladle], for each domain for the gods, for each sacrificial formula"; having taken four ladlings and touched it, he hands it upward.

1.12.19.s: athopabhṛti gṛhṇīte jyotis tvā jyotiṣi dhāmnedhāmne devebhyo yajuṣeyajuṣe gṛhṇāmi | ity etena yajuṣāṣṭagṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā bhūyaso grahān gṛhṇānaḥ kanīya ājyaṃ gṛhṇīte
1.12.19.d: अथोपभृति गृह्णीते ज्योतिस् त्वा ज्योतिषि धाम्नेधाम्ने देवेभ्यो यजुषेयजुषे गृह्णामि । इत्य् एतेन यजुषाष्टगृहीतं गृहीत्वा भूयसो ग्रहान् गृह्णानः कनीय आज्यं गृह्णीते
1.12.19.m: Then he ladles into the upabhṛt ladle with this formula: "I ladle you, light, into the light, for each domain for the gods, for each sacrificial formula"; taking eight ladlings with this, taking larger scoops, he takes a smaller amount of clarified butter.
Just so, having touched it, he hands it upward.

1.12.19.s: atha dhruvāyāṃ gṛhṇīte | arcis tvārciṣi dhāmnedhāmne devebhyo yajuṣeyajuṣe gṛhṇāmi | ity etena yajuṣā caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvābhipūrya tathaiva saṃmṛśyotprayacchati ||
1.12.19.d: अथ ध्रुवायां गृह्णीते । अर्चिस् त्वार्चिषि धाम्नेधाम्ने देवेभ्यो यजुषेयजुषे गृह्णामि । इत्य् एतेन यजुषा चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वाभिपूर्य तथैव संमृश्योत्प्रयच्छति ॥
1.12.19.m: Then he ladles into the dhruvā ladle with this formula: "I ladle you, flame, into the flame, for each domain for the gods, for each sacrificial formula"; having taken four ladlings with this, filling it up, and having touched it just so, he hands it upward.

1.13.19.s: athaitām ājyasthālīm̐ sasruvāṃ jaghanena vedyai nidhāya prokṣaṇīr unmahayann upottiṣṭhati | āpo devīr agrepuvo agreguvo 'gra imaṃ yajñaṃ nayatāgre yajñapatim dhatta yuṣmān indro 'vṛṇīta vṛtratūrye yūyam indram avṛṇīdhvaṃ vṛtratūrye | iti |
1.13.19.d: अथैताम् आज्यस्थालीँ सस्रुवां जघनेन वेद्यै निधाय प्रोक्षणीर् उन्महयन्न् उपोत्तिष्ठति । आपो देवीर् अग्रेपुवो अग्रेगुवो ऽग्र इमं यज्ञं नयताग्रे यज्ञपतिम् धत्त युष्मान् इन्द्रो ऽवृणीत वृत्रतूर्ये यूयम् इन्द्रम् अवृणीध्वं वृत्रतूर्ये । इति ।
1.13.19.m: Then, having placed this clarified butter pot with the sruva ladle behind the altar, he stands up raising the sprinkling waters [with]: "O divine waters, purifying first, moving first, lead this sacrifice forward first, place the lord of the sacrifice first. / Indra chose you in the slaying of Vṛtra; / you chose Indra in the slaying of Vṛtra."

1.13.19.s: adbhir evāpaḥ prokṣati prokṣitā stha prokṣitā stha | iti tris |
1.13.19.d: अद्भिर् एवापः प्रोक्षति प्रोक्षिता स्थ प्रोक्षिता स्थ । इति त्रिस् ।
1.13.19.m: With waters alone he sprinkles the waters three times [saying]: "You are sprinkled," "You are sprinkled."

1.13.19.s: athedhmaṃ visrasya prokṣati kṛṣṇo 'sy ākhareṣṭho 'gnaye tvā svāhā | iti
1.13.19.d: अथेध्मं विस्रस्य प्रोक्षति कृष्णो ऽस्य् आखरेष्ठो ऽग्नये त्वा स्वाहा । इति
1.13.19.m: Then, untying the kindling wood, he sprinkles it [with]: "You are black, standing on the mound; to Agni svāhā!"

1.13.19.s: vediṃ prokṣati vedir asi barhiṣe tvā svāhā | iti
1.13.19.d: वेदिं प्रोक्षति वेदिर् असि बर्हिषे त्वा स्वाहा । इति
1.13.19.m: He sprinkles the altar [with]: "You are the altar; to the sacrificial grass svāhā!"

1.13.19.s: barhiḥ prokṣati barhir asi srugbhyas tvā svāhā | iti | āharanty etad barhir antareṇa praṇītāś cāhavanīyaṃ ca
1.13.19.d: बर्हिः प्रोक्षति बर्हिर् असि स्रुग्भ्यस् त्वा स्वाहा । इति । आहरन्त्य् एतद् बर्हिर् अन्तरेण प्रणीताश् चाहवनीयं च
1.13.19.m: He sprinkles the sacrificial grass [with]: "You are sacrificial grass; to the ladles svāhā!" / They bring this sacrificial grass between the praṇītā waters and the āhavanīya fire.

1.13.19.s: tad antarvedi purogranthyāsādya prokṣati dive tvā | ity agrāṇi | antarikṣāya tvā | iti madhyāni pṛthivyai tvā | iti mūlāni
1.13.19.d: तद् अन्तर्वेदि पुरोग्रन्थ्यासाद्य प्रोक्षति दिवे त्वा । इत्य् अग्राणि । अन्तरिक्षाय त्वा । इति मध्यानि पृथिव्यै त्वा । इति मूलानि
1.13.19.m: Having placed it inside the altar with its knot to the east, he sprinkles it: the tips with "To heaven [thee]", the middles with "To the intermediate space [thee]", the roots with "To the earth [thee]".

1.13.19.s: saha srucā purastātpratyañcaṃ granthiṃ pratyukṣyātiśiṣṭāḥ prokṣaṇīr ninayati dakṣiṇāyai śroṇer ottarāyai śroṇes | svadhā pitṛbhyas | ūrg bhava barhiṣadbhyas | ūrjā pṛthivīṃ gacchata | ity udūhya prokṣaṇīdhānaṃ barhir visrasya purastāt prastaraṃ gṛhṇāti viṣṇo stūpo 'si | iti
1.13.19.d: सह स्रुचा पुरस्तात्प्रत्यञ्चं ग्रन्थिं प्रत्युक्ष्यातिशिष्टाः प्रोक्षणीर् निनयति दक्षिणायै श्रोणेर् ओत्तरायै श्रोणेस् । स्वधा पितृभ्यस् । ऊर्ग् भव बर्हिषद्भ्यस् । ऊर्जा पृथिवीं गच्छत । इत्य् उदूह्य प्रोक्षणीधानं बर्हिर् विस्रस्य पुरस्तात् प्रस्तरं गृह्णाति विष्णो स्तूपो ऽसि । इति
1.13.19.m: Along with the ladle, having sprinkled the knot from front to back, he pours out the remaining sprinkling waters from the southern hip to the northern hip [with]: "Svadhā to the fathers!", "Be refreshment to those sitting on the sacrificial grass!", "Go to the earth with refreshment!" Having pushed away the receptacle of the sprinkling waters and untied the sacrificial grass, he takes the grass bundle from the front [with]: "You are the tuft of Viṣṇu."

1.13.20.s: tasmin pavitre apisṛjati yajamāne prāṇāpānau dadhāmi | iti vā tūṣṇīṃ vā
1.13.20.d: तस्मिन् पवित्रे अपिसृजति यजमाने प्राणापानौ दधामि । इति वा तूष्णीं वा
1.13.20.m: He attaches the two purifiers to it, either with: "I place the out-breath and the in-breath in the sacrificer," or silently.

1.13.20.s: taṃ yajamānāya vā brahmaṇe vā prayacchati |
1.13.20.d: तं यजमानाय वा ब्रह्मणे वा प्रयच्छति ।
1.13.20.m: He hands it either to the sacrificer or to the brahman priest.

1.13.20.s: athaitāni barhiḥsaṃnahanāny āyātayati dakṣiṇāyai śroṇer ottarād am̐sāt |
1.13.20.d: अथैतानि बर्हिःसंनहनान्य् आयातयति दक्षिणायै श्रोणेर् ओत्तराद् अँसात् ।
1.13.20.m: Then he stretches out these ties of the sacrificial grass from the southern hip to the northern shoulder.

1.13.20.s: atha dakṣiṇe vedyante barhirmuṣṭim̐ stṛṇāti devabarhis | ūrṇāmradasaṃ tvā stṛṇāmi svāsasthaṃ devebhyas | iti
1.13.20.d: अथ दक्षिणे वेद्यन्ते बर्हिर्मुष्टिँ स्तृणाति देवबर्हिस् । ऊर्णाम्रदसं त्वा स्तृणामि स्वासस्थं देवेभ्यस् । इति
1.13.20.m: Then he strews a handful of sacrificial grass along the southern edge of the altar [with]: "O divine sacrificial grass, / I strew you soft as wool, offering a good seat to the gods."

1.13.20.s: tāṃ bahulāṃ purastāt pratīcīṃ trivṛtam anatidṛśnam̐ stṛṇāti |
1.13.20.d: तां बहुलां पुरस्तात् प्रतीचीं त्रिवृतम् अनतिदृश्नँ स्तृणाति ।
1.13.20.m: He strews it thick, pointing west from the east, threefold, not too thin.

1.13.20.s: atha prastarapāṇiḥ prāṅ abhisṛpya paridhīn paridadhāti gandharvo 'si viśvāvasus | viśvasmād īṣatas | yajamānasya paridhir iḍa īḍitas | iti madhyamam indrasya bāhur asi dakṣiṇas | yajamānasya paridhir iḍa īḍitas | iti dakṣiṇam | mitrāvaruṇau tvottarataḥ paridhattāṃ dhruveṇa dharmaṇā yajamānasya paridhir iḍa īḍitas | ity uttaram
1.13.20.d: अथ प्रस्तरपाणिः प्राङ् अभिसृप्य परिधीन् परिदधाति गन्धर्वो ऽसि विश्वावसुस् । विश्वस्माद् ईषतस् । यजमानस्य परिधिर् इड ईडितस् । इति मध्यमम् इन्द्रस्य बाहुर् असि दक्षिणस् । यजमानस्य परिधिर् इड ईडितस् । इति दक्षिणम् । मित्रावरुणौ त्वोत्तरतः परिधत्तां ध्रुवेण धर्मणा यजमानस्य परिधिर् इड ईडितस् । इत्य् उत्तरम्
1.13.20.m: Then, holding the grass bundle in hand, creeping forward eastward, he sets the enclosing sticks around: the middle one with "You are the gandharva Viśvāvasu, / an enclosing stick for the sacrificer / praised by Iḍā from every fleeting danger"; the southern one with "You are Indra's right arm, / an enclosing stick for the sacrificer / praised by Iḍā"; the northern one with "May Mitra and Varuṇa set you round on the north with firm law, / an enclosing stick for the sacrificer / praised by Iḍā."

1.13.20.s: atha sūryeṇa purastāt paridadhāti sūryas tvā purastāt pātu kasyāś cid abhiśastyās | iti |
1.13.20.d: अथ सूर्येण पुरस्तात् परिदधाति सूर्यस् त्वा पुरस्तात् पातु कस्याश् चिद् अभिशस्त्यास् । इति ।
1.13.20.m: Then he encloses in front with Sūrya [with]: "May Sūrya protect you in front from any curse."

1.13.20.s: ūrdhve samidhāv ādadhāti vītihotraṃ tvā kave dyumantam̐ samidhīmahi | agne bṛhantam adhvare | iti dakṣiṇāṃ tūṣṇīm uttarām abhyādhāya |
1.13.20.d: ऊर्ध्वे समिधाव् आदधाति वीतिहोत्रं त्वा कवे द्युमन्तँ समिधीमहि । अग्ने बृहन्तम् अध्वरे । इति दक्षिणां तूष्णीम् उत्तराम् अभ्याधाय ।
1.13.20.m: He puts on two upright kindling sticks: having put on the southern one with "You, the invoker of feasts, O sage, / brilliant, may we kindle, / O Agni, the great one in the rite", and the northern one silently,

1.13.20.s: antarvedy udīcīnāgre vidhṛtī tiraścī sādayati viśo yantre sthas | iti
1.13.20.d: अन्तर्वेद्य् उदीचीनाग्रे विधृती तिरश्ची सादयति विशो यन्त्रे स्थस् । इति
1.13.20.m: he places the two transverse separators pointing northward inside the altar [with]: "You two are the restrainers of the people."

1.13.20.s: vidhṛtyoḥ prastaram | vasūnām̐ rudrāṇām ādityānām̐ sadasi sīda | iti
1.13.20.d: विधृत्योः प्रस्तरम् । वसूनाँ रुद्राणाम् आदित्यानाँ सदसि सीद । इति
1.13.20.m: On the two separators [he places] the grass bundle [with]: "Sit in the seat of the Vasus, the Rudras, the Ādityas."

1.13.20.s: prastare juhūm | juhūr asi ghṛtācī nāmnā priyeṇa nāmnā priye sadasi sīda | iti |
1.13.20.d: प्रस्तरे जुहूम् । जुहूर् असि घृताची नाम्ना प्रियेण नाम्ना प्रिये सदसि सीद । इति ।
1.13.20.m: On the grass bundle [he places] the juhū ladle [with]: "You are the juhū, ghṛtācī by name; sit in your dear seat with your dear name."

1.13.20.s: uttarām upabhṛtam upabhṛd asi ghṛtācī nāmnā priyeṇa nāmnā priye sadasi sīda | iti |
1.13.20.d: उत्तराम् उपभृतम् उपभृद् असि घृताची नाम्ना प्रियेण नाम्ना प्रिये सदसि सीद । इति ।
1.13.20.m: To the north of it the upabhṛt ladle [with]: "You are the upabhṛt, ghṛtācī by name; sit in your dear seat with your dear name."

1.13.20.s: uttarāṃ dhruvām | dhruvāsi ghṛtācī nāmnā priyeṇa nāmnā priye sadasi sīda | iti |
1.13.20.d: उत्तरां ध्रुवाम् । ध्रुवासि घृताची नाम्ना प्रियेण नाम्ना प्रिये सदसि सीद । इति ।
1.13.20.m: To the north of it the dhruvā ladle [with]: "You are the dhruvā, ghṛtācī by name; sit in your dear seat with your dear name."

1.13.20.s: atha srucaḥ sannā abhimṛśati | etā asadant sukṛtasya loke tā viṣṇo pāhi pāhi yajñam | pāhi yajñapatim | pāhi māṃ yajñaniyam iti |
1.13.20.d: अथ स्रुचः सन्ना अभिमृशति । एता असदन्त् सुकृतस्य लोके ता विष्णो पाहि पाहि यज्ञम् । पाहि यज्ञपतिम् । पाहि मां यज्ञनियम् इति ।
1.13.20.m: Then he touches the ladles when they are laid down [with]: "These have sat down in the realm of good deeds; protect them, O Viṣṇu; protect the sacrifice; protect the lord of the sacrifice; protect me, the leader of the sacrifice."

1.13.21.s: atha viṣṇūni stha vaiṣṇavāni dhāmāni stha prājāpatyāni | ity ājyāny abhimantrayate ||
1.13.21.d: अथ विष्णूनि स्थ वैष्णवानि धामानि स्थ प्राजापत्यानि । इत्य् आज्यान्य् अभिमन्त्रयते ॥
1.13.21.m: Then he addresses the clarified butter portions with the formula: "You are Viṣṇu-like; you are the dwellings belonging to Viṣṇu, belonging to Prajāpati."

1.14.21.s: athādatte dakṣiṇenājyasthālīm̐ sasruvām̐ savyena pātrīṃ vedam iti |
1.14.21.d: अथादत्ते दक्षिणेनाज्यस्थालीँ सस्रुवाँ सव्येन पात्रीं वेदम् इति ।
1.14.21.m: Then with his right [hand] he takes up the clarified butter pot along with the ladle, and with his left the baking vessel [and] the broom.

1.14.21.s: etat samādāya pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya pratyaṅṅ ādrutya jaghanena gārhapatyam upaviśya pātryāṃ dvedhopastṛṇīte syonaṃ te sadanaṃ karomi ghṛtasya dhārayā suśevaṃ kalpayāmi | tasmint sīdāmṛte pratitiṣṭha vrīhīṇāṃ medha sumanasyamānas | iti |
1.14.21.d: एतत् समादाय प्रदक्षिणम् आवृत्य प्रत्यङ्ङ् आद्रुत्य जघनेन गार्हपत्यम् उपविश्य पात्र्यां द्वेधोपस्तृणीते स्योनं ते सदनं करोमि घृतस्य धारया सुशेवं कल्पयामि । तस्मिन्त् सीदामृते प्रतितिष्ठ व्रीहीणां मेध सुमनस्यमानस् । इति ।
1.14.21.m: Taking these up, turning clockwise, running toward the west, and sitting down behind the gārhapatya fire, he spreads an under-layer [of clarified butter] in two places in the pan with the verse: "I make for you a soft seat, I arrange it pleasantly with a stream of clarified butter. / Sit upon that, stand firm upon the nectar, essence of rice grains, being well-disposed."

1.14.21.s: atha dhṛṣṭim ādāya dakṣiṇasya puroḍāśasyāṅgārān apohati | idam aham̐ senāyā abhītvaryai mukham apohāmi | iti |
1.14.21.d: अथ धृष्टिम् आदाय दक्षिणस्य पुरोडाशस्याङ्गारान् अपोहति । इदम् अहँ सेनाया अभीत्वर्यै मुखम् अपोहामि । इति ।
1.14.21.m: Then, taking the fire-poker, he pushes away the burning embers from the southern cake with the formula: "Here I push away the face of the encroaching army."

1.14.21.s: athainaṃ vidarśayati sūrya jyotir vibhāhi mahata indriyāya | iti
1.14.21.d: अथैनं विदर्शयति सूर्य ज्योतिर् विभाहि महत इन्द्रियाय । इति
1.14.21.m: Then he reveals it with the formula: "O Sūrya, shine your light for great power of the senses!"

1.14.21.s: vedena virajasaṃ kṛtvābhighārayati | āpyāyatāṃ ghṛtayonir agnir havyānumanyatām | kham aṅkṣva tvacam aṅkṣva surūpaṃ tvā vasuvidaṃ paśūnāṃ tejasāgnaye juṣṭam abhighārayāmi | iti
1.14.21.d: वेदेन विरजसं कृत्वाभिघारयति । आप्यायतां घृतयोनिर् अग्निर् हव्यानुमन्यताम् । खम् अङ्क्ष्व त्वचम् अङ्क्ष्व सुरूपं त्वा वसुविदं पशूनां तेजसाग्नये जुष्टम् अभिघारयामि । इति
1.14.21.m: Having dusted it off with the broom, he sprinkles clarified butter over it with the verse: "May Agni, whose source is clarified butter, be enriched; may he approve the oblations. / Anoint your cavity, anoint your skin; you of handsome form, finder of wealth, with the vigor of cattle, I sprinkle you agreeable to Agni,"

1.14.21.s: athainam udvāsayati śṛta utsnāti janitā matīnām iti |
1.14.21.d: अथैनम् उद्वासयति शृत उत्स्नाति जनिता मतीनाम् इति ।
1.14.21.m: Then he removes it [from the potsherd] with the formula: "The cooked [offering], father of thoughts, rises out."

1.14.21.s: ājyena susaṃtarpayati | ārdraḥ prathasnur bhuvanasya gopās | iti | upariṣṭād abhyajyādhastād upānakti yas ta ātmā paśuṣu praviṣṭas tam aṅkṣva | iti |
1.14.21.d: आज्येन सुसंतर्पयति । आर्द्रः प्रथस्नुर् भुवनस्य गोपास् । इति । उपरिष्टाद् अभ्यज्याधस्ताद् उपानक्ति यस् त आत्मा पशुषु प्रविष्टस् तम् अङ्क्ष्व । इति ।
1.14.21.m: He thoroughly satisfies it with clarified butter with the formula: "Moist, spreading, protector of the world." / Having anointed it from above, he anoints it beneath with the formula: "That self of yours which entered into cattle, anoint that."
In this very manner he removes the northern cake.

1.14.21.s: atha śṛtam atha dadhi | atha sāṃnāyye alaṃkaroti yas ta ātmā paśuṣu praviṣṭo devānāṃ viṣṭhām anu yo vitasthe | ātmanvānt soma ghṛtavān hi bhūtvā devān gaccha suvar vinda yajamānāya mahyam iti
1.14.21.d: अथ शृतम् अथ दधि । अथ सांनाय्ये अलंकरोति यस् त आत्मा पशुषु प्रविष्टो देवानां विष्ठाम् अनु यो वितस्थे । आत्मन्वान्त् सोम घृतवान् हि भूत्वा देवान् गच्छ सुवर् विन्द यजमानाय मह्यम् इति
1.14.21.m: Then the boiled [milk], then the sour milk; then he adorns the curd-and-milk oblation with the verse: "That self of yours which entered into cattle, which extended itself along the station of the gods, / having become endowed with self, O Soma, and possessing clarified butter, go to the gods, find heaven for me, the sacrificer!"

1.14.21.s: pratyajya kapālāny udvāsayati | irā bhūtiḥ pṛthivyai raso motkramīt | iti
1.14.21.d: प्रत्यज्य कपालान्य् उद्वासयति । इरा भूतिः पृथिव्यै रसो मोत्क्रमीत् । इति
1.14.21.m: Having smeared the potsherds in reverse, he removes them with the formula: "May invigorating sap, prosperity, the essence of the earth, not depart."
"He removes them after counting them, for the protection of the sacrificer," so says the brāhmaṇa passage.

1.14.22.s: athainam̐ sruvam ājyasya pūrayitvānatareṇa puroḍāśāv avadadhāti |
1.14.22.d: अथैनँ स्रुवम् आज्यस्य पूरयित्वानतरेण पुरोडाशाव् अवदधाति ।
1.14.22.m: Then, having filled this ladle with clarified butter, he sets it down between the two cakes.

1.14.22.s: athaināni saṃparigṛhyāntarvedy āsādayati bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar ity etābhir vyāhṛtībhis |
1.14.22.d: अथैनानि संपरिगृह्यान्तर्वेद्य् आसादयति भूर् भुवः सुवर् इत्य् एताभिर् व्याहृतीभिस् ।
1.14.22.m: Then, grasping them all together, he places them within the altar with these sacred utterances: "Bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar!"

1.14.22.s: madhyataḥ puroḍāśāv āsādayati dakṣiṇataḥ śṛtam uttarato dadhi |
1.14.22.d: मध्यतः पुरोडाशाव् आसादयति दक्षिणतः शृतम् उत्तरतो दधि ।
1.14.22.m: He places the two cakes in the middle, the boiled [milk] to the south, and the sour milk to the north.

1.14.22.s: athainam̐ sruvam agreṇa srucaḥ paryāhṛtya dakṣiṇena juhūṃ prasatre sādayati syono me sīda suṣadaḥ pṛthivyāṃ prathayi prajayā paśubhiḥ suvarge loke | divi sīda pṛthivyām antarikṣe 'ham uttaro bhūyāsam adhare mat sapatnās | iti |
1.14.22.d: अथैनँ स्रुवम् अग्रेण स्रुचः पर्याहृत्य दक्षिणेन जुहूं प्रसत्रे सादयति स्योनो मे सीद सुषदः पृथिव्यां प्रथयि प्रजया पशुभिः सुवर्गे लोके । दिवि सीद पृथिव्याम् अन्तरिक्षे ऽहम् उत्तरो भूयासम् अधरे मत् सपत्नास् । इति ।
1.14.22.m: Then, bringing this ladle around in front of the offering ladles, he places it on the grass bundle to the south of the juhū ladle with the verse: "Sit soft for me, well-seated upon the earth, spreading through offspring [and] cattle in the heavenly world. / Sit in heaven, upon earth, in the intermediate space; may I be above, and my rivals below me."

1.14.22.s: athainaṃ yathāhṛtaṃ pratiparyāhṛtya dhruvāyām avadadhāti | ṛṣabho 'si śākvaro ghṛtācīnām̐ sūnuḥ priyeṇa nāmnā priye sadasi sīda | iti ||
1.14.22.d: अथैनं यथाहृतं प्रतिपर्याहृत्य ध्रुवायाम् अवदधाति । ऋषभो ऽसि शाक्वरो घृताचीनाँ सूनुः प्रियेण नाम्ना प्रिये सदसि सीद । इति ॥
1.14.22.m: Then, bringing it back around as it was brought, he sets it down in the dhruvā ladle with the verse: "You are the bull, mighty, son of the clarified butter ladles; sit down with your dear name in your dear seat."

1.15.22.s: athedhmāt samidham ādadāna āha | agnaye samidhyamānāyānubrūhi | iti |
1.15.22.d: अथेध्मात् समिधम् आददान आह । अग्नये समिध्यमानायानुब्रूहि । इति ।
1.15.22.m: Then, taking a kindling stick from the kindling wood, he says: "Recite for Agni as he is being kindled!"

1.15.22.s: atha yatra hotur abhijānāti pra vo vājā abhidyavas | iti tatprathamām abhyādadhāti
1.15.22.d: अथ यत्र होतुर् अभिजानाति प्र वो वाजा अभिद्यवस् । इति तत्प्रथमाम् अभ्यादधाति
1.15.22.m: Then, when he recognizes [the words] of the hotṛ priest, "Forward your glorious prizes...", at that point he puts on the first [stick].

1.15.22.s: praṇavepraṇave 'bhyādadhāti | atha yatra hotur abhijānāti samiddho agna āhuta | iti tadantato 'bhyādadhāti
1.15.22.d: प्रणवेप्रणवे ऽभ्यादधाति । अथ यत्र होतुर् अभिजानाति समिद्धो अग्न आहुत । इति तदन्ततो ऽभ्यादधाति
1.15.22.m: At every praṇava he puts one on. Then, when he recognizes [the words] of the hotṛ priest, "Kindled, O Agni, invoked...", at that point he puts on the last one.

1.15.22.s: pari samidham̐ śinaṣṭi | atha yatra hotur abhijānāti | ājuhotā duvasyata | iti tad etena vedena trir āhavanīyam upavājayati |
1.15.22.d: परि समिधँ शिनष्टि । अथ यत्र होतुर् अभिजानाति । आजुहोता दुवस्यत । इति तद् एतेन वेदेन त्रिर् आहवनीयम् उपवाजयति ।
1.15.22.m: He leaves over a kindling stick. Then, when he recognizes [the words] of the hotṛ priest, "Offer sacrifice, attend [upon him]...", at that point he fans the āhavanīya fire three times with this broom.

1.15.22.s: anūktāsu sāmidhenīṣu dhruvājyāt sruveṇopahatya vedenopayamya prājāpatyaṃ tiryañcam āghāram āghārayati prajāpataye svāhā | iti manasā |
1.15.22.d: अनूक्तासु सामिधेनीषु ध्रुवाज्यात् स्रुवेणोपहत्य वेदेनोपयम्य प्राजापत्यं तिर्यञ्चम् आघारम् आघारयति प्रजापतये स्वाहा । इति मनसा ।
1.15.22.m: When the sāmidhenī verses have been recited, having scooped [butter] from the dhruvā ladle's clarified butter with the ladle, and supporting it with the broom, he pours a crosswise libation to Prajāpati, reciting in his mind: "To Prajāpati svāhā!"

1.15.23.s: atha saṃpraiṣam āha | agnīd agnīm̐s tristriḥ saṃmṛḍḍhi | iti |
1.15.23.d: अथ संप्रैषम् आह । अग्नीद् अग्नीँस् त्रिस्त्रिः संमृड्ढि । इति ।
1.15.23.m: Then he issues the direction: "O Agnīdh, sweep around the fires three times each!"

1.15.23.s: athaiṣa āgnīdhra idhmasaṃnahanāni sphya upasaṃgṛhya paridhīn saṃmārṣṭi trir madhyamaṃ trir dakṣiṇārdhyaṃ trir uttarārdhyaṃ trir āhavanīyam upavājayati | agne vājajid vājaṃ tvāgne sariṣyantaṃ vājaṃ jeṣyantaṃ vājinaṃ vājajitaṃ vājajityāyai saṃmārjmy agnim annādam annādyāya | iti |
1.15.23.d: अथैष आग्नीध्र इध्मसंनहनानि स्फ्य उपसंगृह्य परिधीन् संमार्ष्टि त्रिर् मध्यमं त्रिर् दक्षिणार्ध्यं त्रिर् उत्तरार्ध्यं त्रिर् आहवनीयम् उपवाजयति । अग्ने वाजजिद् वाजं त्वाग्ने सरिष्यन्तं वाजं जेष्यन्तं वाजिनं वाजजितं वाजजित्यायै संमार्ज्म्य् अग्निम् अन्नादम् अन्नाद्याय । इति ।
1.15.23.m: Then this Āgnīdhra, grasping the cords that bound the kindling wood with the wooden sword, sweeps around the enclosing sticks: three times the middle one, three times the southern one, three times the northern one; and he fans the āhavanīya fire three times with the formula: "O Agni, winner of the prize, you who will run for the prize, who will win the prize, swift, winning the prize, I cleanse Agni, the eater of food, for the eating of food!"

1.15.23.s: athāgreṇa juhūpabhṛtau prāñcam añjaliṃ karoti bhuvanam asi viprathasva | agne yaṣṭar idaṃ namas | iti |
1.15.23.d: अथाग्रेण जुहूपभृतौ प्राञ्चम् अञ्जलिं करोति भुवनम् असि विप्रथस्व । अग्ने यष्टर् इदं नमस् । इति ।
1.15.23.m: Then, in front of the juhū and upabhṛt ladles, he makes an añjali facing east with the formulas: "You are the world, expand widely!" [and] "O Agni the sacrificer, this homage [to you]!"

1.15.23.s: athādatte dakṣiṇena juhūm | juhv ehy agnis tvā hvayati devayajyāyai | iti
1.15.23.d: अथादत्ते दक्षिणेन जुहूम् । जुह्व् एह्य् अग्निस् त्वा ह्वयति देवयज्यायै । इति
1.15.23.m: Then he takes up the juhū ladle with his right [hand], saying: "O juhū, come; Agni calls you to the worship of the gods!"

1.15.23.s: savyenopabhṛtam upabhṛd ehi devas tvā savitā hvayati devayajyāyai | iti
1.15.23.d: सव्येनोपभृतम् उपभृद् एहि देवस् त्वा सविता ह्वयति देवयज्यायै । इति
1.15.23.m: With his left the upabhṛt ladle, saying: "O upabhṛt, come; the divine Savitar calls you to the worship of the gods!"

1.15.23.s: savyenātyākrāmañjapati | agnāviṣṇū mā vām avakramiṣam | vijihāthāṃ mā mā saṃtāptam | lokaṃ me lokakṛtau kṛṇutam iti
1.15.23.d: सव्येनात्याक्रामञ्जपति । अग्नाविष्णू मा वाम् अवक्रमिषम् । विजिहाथां मा मा संताप्तम् । लोकं मे लोककृतौ कृणुतम् इति
1.15.23.m: Stepping across with his left [foot], he mutters: "O Agni and Viṣṇu, may I not trample upon you two! Part asunder, do not scorch me! Creators of space, make space for me!"

1.15.23.s: sthānaṃ kalpayate viṣṇo sthānam asi | iti |
1.15.23.d: स्थानं कल्पयते विष्णो स्थानम् असि । इति ।
1.15.23.m: He assumes his position with the formula: "You are the place of Viṣṇu."

1.15.23.s: anvārabdhe yajamāne madhyame paridhau sam̐sparśyarjum āghāram āghārayati saṃtataṃ prāñcam avyavacchindan | ita indro akṛṇod vīryāṇi samārabhyordhvo adhvaro divispṛśam ahruto yajño yajñapates | indrāvānt svāhā | iti
1.15.23.d: अन्वारब्धे यजमाने मध्यमे परिधौ सँस्पर्श्यर्जुम् आघारम् आघारयति संततं प्राञ्चम् अव्यवच्छिन्दन् । इत इन्द्रो अकृणोद् वीर्याणि समारभ्योर्ध्वो अध्वरो दिविस्पृशम् अह्रुतो यज्ञो यज्ञपतेस् । इन्द्रावान्त् स्वाहा । इति
1.15.23.m: While the sacrificer holds onto him from behind, touching the middle enclosing stick, he pours a straight libation, continuously eastward without interrupting it, with the verse: "From here Indra performed his heroic deeds; taking hold, the sacrificial rite has risen upward to touch the sky; unswerving is the sacrifice of the lord of the sacrifice; possessing Indra, svāhā!"
He raises the ladle with the formula: "Great light!"

1.15.23.s: athāsam̐sparśayan srucāv udaṅṅ atyākrāmañ japati pāhi māgne duścaritād ā mā sucarite bhaja | iti
1.15.23.d: अथासँस्पर्शयन् स्रुचाव् उदङ्ङ् अत्याक्रामञ् जपति पाहि माग्ने दुश्चरिताद् आ मा सुचरिते भज । इति
1.15.23.m: Then, not letting the two ladles touch each other, stepping across toward the north, he mutters: "Protect me, O Agni, from bad conduct; assign me to good conduct!"

1.15.23.s: juhvā dhruvām̐ samanakti makhasya śiro 'si saṃ jyotiṣā jyotir aṅktām iti tris |
1.15.23.d: जुह्वा ध्रुवाँ समनक्ति मखस्य शिरो ऽसि सं ज्योतिषा ज्योतिर् अङ्क्ताम् इति त्रिस् ।
1.15.23.m: With the juhū he anoints the dhruvā three times, saying: "You are the head of Makha; may light unite with light!"

1.15.23.s: atha yathāyatanam̐ srucau sādayitvā pravaraṃ pravṛṇīte |
1.15.23.d: अथ यथायतनँ स्रुचौ सादयित्वा प्रवरं प्रवृणीते ।
1.15.23.m: Then, having set down the two ladles in their proper places, he chooses the ancestral invocation.

1.15.23.s: utkara idhmasaṃnahanāni sphya upasaṃgṛhya pṛṣṭham āgnīdhro 'nūpaśliṣyati |
1.15.23.d: उत्कर इध्मसंनहनानि स्फ्य उपसंगृह्य पृष्ठम् आग्नीध्रो ऽनूपश्लिष्यति ।
1.15.23.m: At the rubbish heap, holding the cords that bound the kindling wood with the wooden sword, the Āgnīdhra stands close along the ridge [of the altar].

1.15.24.s: athāśrāvayati | o śrāvaya | astu śrauṣaṭ | agnir devo hotā devān yakṣad vidvām̐ś cikitvān manuṣvad bharatavad amuvad amuvat | brahmaṇvad eha vakṣat | brāhmaṇā asya yajñasya prāvitāras | iti | asau mānuṣas | iti hotur nāma gṛhṇāti |
1.15.24.d: अथाश्रावयति । ओ श्रावय । अस्तु श्रौषट् । अग्निर् देवो होता देवान् यक्षद् विद्वाँश् चिकित्वान् मनुष्वद् भरतवद् अमुवद् अमुवत् । ब्रह्मण्वद् एह वक्षत् । ब्राह्मणा अस्य यज्ञस्य प्रावितारस् । इति । असौ मानुषस् । इति होतुर् नाम गृह्णाति ।
1.15.24.m: Then he makes the call: "Make call!" — "May there be śrauṣaṭ!" — "Agni is the divine hotṛ; may he sacrifice to the gods, knowing, wise, as did Manu, as did Bharata, as did so-and-so, as did so-and-so! / May he bring [the gods] here endowed with brahman! / The brāhmaṇas are the protectors of this sacrifice." He mentions the human hotṛ priest's name, saying: "So-and-so is the human [hotṛ]."
Standing up nearby, the hotṛ priest releases [the ancestral invocation].

1.15.24.d: विमुक्तो ऽध्वर्युर् उपविशति प्रसवम् आकाङ्क्षन्न् आस्ते ॥
1.15.24.m: Having been released, the adhvaryu priest sits down; he sits awaiting the impulse.

1.16.24.s: atha yatra hotur abhijānāti ghṛtavatīm adhvaryo srucam āsyasva | iti taj juhūpabhṛtāv ādāyātyākramyāśrāvyāha samidho yaja | iti
1.16.24.d: अथ यत्र होतुर् अभिजानाति घृतवतीम् अध्वर्यो स्रुचम् आस्यस्व । इति तज् जुहूपभृताव् आदायात्याक्रम्याश्राव्याह समिधो यज । इति
1.16.24.m: Then, when he recognizes [the words] of the hotṛ priest, "Adhvaryu, take up the ladle filled with clarified butter!", at that point, taking up the juhū and the upabhṛt, stepping across, and making the call, he says: "Sacrifice to the kindling sticks!"
When the vaṣaṭ call has been uttered, he offers, saying [at each subsequent offering]: "Sacrifice! Sacrifice!"

1.16.24.s: caturthaṃ yakṣyann ardham aupabhṛtasyājyasya juhvām̐ samānayate
1.16.24.d: चतुर्थं यक्ष्यन्न् अर्धम् औपभृतस्याज्यस्य जुह्वाँ समानयते
1.16.24.m: About to offer the fourth sacrifice, he pours half of the clarified butter of the upabhṛt into the juhū.

1.16.24.s: pañca prayājān iṣṭvodaṅṅ atyākramya sam̐srāveṇānupūrvam̐ havīm̐ṣy abhighārayati dhruvām evāgre 'tha dakṣiṇaṃ puroḍāśam atha dhruvām athottaraṃ puroḍāśam atha śṛtam atha dadhyupabhṛtam antatas |
1.16.24.d: पञ्च प्रयाजान् इष्ट्वोदङ्ङ् अत्याक्रम्य सँस्रावेणानुपूर्वँ हवीँष्य् अभिघारयति ध्रुवाम् एवाग्रे ऽथ दक्षिणं पुरोडाशम् अथ ध्रुवाम् अथोत्तरं पुरोडाशम् अथ शृतम् अथ दध्युपभृतम् अन्ततस् ।
1.16.24.m: Having offered the five fore-offerings, having stepped across to the north, he sprinkles the oblations in order with the trickle [of ghee]: first the dhruvā ladle itself, then the southern cake, then the dhruvā ladle, then the northern cake, then the boiled [milk], then the curd, [and] the upabhṛt ladle at the end.

1.16.24.s: atha catura ājyasya gṛhṇāna āha | agnaye 'nubrūhi | iti |
1.16.24.d: अथ चतुर आज्यस्य गृह्णान आह । अग्नये ऽनुब्रूहि । इति ।
1.16.24.m: Then, taking four portions of ghee, he says, 'Recite for Agni.'
Having stepped across, having made the call, he says, 'Worship Agni.'

1.16.24.s: vaṣaṭkṛta uttarārdhapūrvārdhe pratimukhaṃ prabāhug juhoti | athodaṅṅ atyākramya catura evājyasya gṛhṇāna āha somāyānubrūhi | iti |
1.16.24.d: वषट्कृत उत्तरार्धपूर्वार्धे प्रतिमुखं प्रबाहुग् जुहोति । अथोदङ्ङ् अत्याक्रम्य चतुर एवाज्यस्य गृह्णान आह सोमायानुब्रूहि । इति ।
1.16.24.m: When the vaṣaṭ call has been made, he pours the offering in front, straight out in the northeastern quarter. Then, having stepped across to the north, taking four portions of ghee, he says, 'Recite for Soma.'
Having stepped across, having made the call, he says, 'Worship Soma.'
When the vaṣaṭ call has been made, he pours the offering in front, straight out in the southeastern quarter.

1.16.24.s: athopastīrya dakṣiṇasya puroḍāśasya pūrvārdhād avadyann āha | agnaye 'nubrūhi | iti |
1.16.24.d: अथोपस्तीर्य दक्षिणस्य पुरोडाशस्य पूर्वार्धाद् अवद्यन्न् आह । अग्नये ऽनुब्रूहि । इति ।
1.16.24.m: Then, having made an underlayer [of ghee], cutting a portion from the eastern half of the southern cake, he says, 'Recite for Agni.'

1.16.24.s: athainam upatiṣṭhate mā bhes | mā saṃvikthās | mā tvā him̐siṣam | mā te tejo 'pakramīt | iti |
1.16.24.d: अथैनम् उपतिष्ठते मा भेस् । मा संविक्थास् । मा त्वा हिँसिषम् । मा ते तेजो ऽपक्रमीत् । इति ।
1.16.24.m: Then he pays homage to it with: 'Do not fear; do not tremble; may I not harm you; may your splendor not depart.'

1.16.25.s: athainam abhimṛśati bharatam uddhare manuṣiñcāvadānāni te pratyavadāsyāmi namas te astu mā mā him̐sīs | iti
1.16.25.d: अथैनम् अभिमृशति भरतम् उद्धरे मनुषिञ्चावदानानि ते प्रत्यवदास्यामि नमस् ते अस्तु मा मा हिँसीस् । इति
1.16.25.m: Then he touches it with: 'O Bharata, take up; pour into manuṣa; I shall place portions back in place for you; homage be to you; do not harm me.'

1.16.25.s: pūrvārdhād avadāyāparārdhād avadyati | abhighārayati pratyanakti yad avadānāni te 'vadyan vilomākārṣam ātmanaḥ | ājyena pratyanajmy enat tat ta āpyāyatāṃ punar iti |
1.16.25.d: पूर्वार्धाद् अवदायापरार्धाद् अवद्यति । अभिघारयति प्रत्यनक्ति यद् अवदानानि ते ऽवद्यन् विलोमाकार्षम् आत्मनः । आज्येन प्रत्यनज्म्य् एनत् तत् त आप्यायतां पुनर् इति ।
1.16.25.m: Having cut a portion from the eastern half, he cuts a portion from the western half. He sprinkles it and anoints it in return with: 'If, cutting your portions, I have acted against your grain, I anoint this in return with ghee; let that swell up again for you.'
Having stepped across, having made the call, he says, 'Worship Agni.'

1.16.25.s: vaṣaṭkṛte juhoti | atha catura ājyasya gṛhṇāna āha "prajāpataye" | ity upām̐śu | "anubrūhi" | ity uccais |
1.16.25.d: वषट्कृते जुहोति । अथ चतुर आज्यस्य गृह्णान आह "प्रजापतये" । इत्य् उपाँशु । "अनुब्रूहि" । इत्य् उच्चैस् ।
1.16.25.m: When the vaṣaṭ call has been made, he pours the offering. Then, taking four portions of ghee, he says in a low voice, 'For Prajāpati,' [and] loudly, 'Recite.'
Having stepped across, having made the call, he says in a low voice, 'Prajāpati,' [and] loudly, 'Worship.'

1.16.25.s: vaṣaṭkṛte juhoti | athopastīryottarasya puroḍāśasyāparārdhād avadyann āha | "agnīṣomābhyām" iti paurṇamāsyām "indrāya vaimṛdhāya" | iti ca | "indrāgnibhyām" ity amāvāsyāyām asaṃnayatas | "indrāya" | iti saṃnayatas | "mahendrāya" | iti vā yadi mahendrayājī bhavati ||
1.16.25.d: वषट्कृते जुहोति । अथोपस्तीर्योत्तरस्य पुरोडाशस्यापरार्धाद् अवद्यन्न् आह । "अग्नीषोमाभ्याम्" इति पौर्णमास्याम् "इन्द्राय वैमृधाय" । इति च । "इन्द्राग्निभ्याम्" इत्य् अमावास्यायाम् असंनयतस् । "इन्द्राय" । इति संनयतस् । "महेन्द्राय" । इति वा यदि महेन्द्रयाजी भवति ॥
1.16.25.m: When the vaṣaṭ call has been made, he pours the offering. Then, having made an underlayer, cutting a portion from the western half of the northern cake, he says: 'For Agni and Soma' at the full moon ritual, and 'For Indra Vaimṛdha'; 'For Indra and Agni' at the new moon ritual for one who does not prepare the curd-and-milk oblation; 'For Indra' for one who prepares the curd-and-milk oblation; or 'For Mahendra' if he is a sacrificer to Mahendra.

1.17.25.s: samāna upasthānaḥ samāno 'bhimarśanas | aparārdhād avadāya pūrvārdhād avadyati |
1.17.25.d: समान उपस्थानः समानो ऽभिमर्शनस् । अपरार्धाद् अवदाय पूर्वार्धाद् अवद्यति ।
1.17.25.m: The homage is the same. The touching is the same. Having cut a portion from the western half, he cuts a portion from the eastern half.

1.17.25.s: abhighārayati samānaḥ pratyañjanas | atyākramyāśrāvyāha | agnīṣomau yaja | iti
1.17.25.d: अभिघारयति समानः प्रत्यञ्जनस् । अत्याक्रम्याश्राव्याह । अग्नीषोमौ यज । इति
1.17.25.m: He sprinkles it. The anointing in return is the same. Having stepped across, having made the call, he says, 'Worship Agni and Soma.'

1.17.25.s: vaṣaṭkṛte juhoti | athopastīrya dviḥ puroḍāśasyāvadyann āha | indrāyānubrūhi | iti "mahendrāya" | iti vā yadi mahendrayājī bhavati
1.17.25.d: वषट्कृते जुहोति । अथोपस्तीर्य द्विः पुरोडाशस्यावद्यन्न् आह । इन्द्रायानुब्रूहि । इति "महेन्द्राय" । इति वा यदि महेन्द्रयाजी भवति
1.17.25.m: When the vaṣaṭ call has been made, he pours the offering. Then, having made an underlayer, cutting two portions from the cake, he says, 'Recite for Indra,' or 'For Mahendra' if he is a sacrificer to Mahendra.

1.17.25.s: dviḥ puroḍāśasyāvadyati dviḥ śṛtasya dvir dadhnas | abhighārayati
1.17.25.d: द्विः पुरोडाशस्यावद्यति द्विः शृतस्य द्विर् दध्नस् । अभिघारयति
1.17.25.m: He cuts two portions from the cake, two from the boiled [milk], two from the curd. He sprinkles [them] with ghee.

1.17.25.s: pratyanakti | atyākramyāśrāvyāha | indraṃ yaja | iti "mahendram" iti vā yadi mahendrayājī bhavati
1.17.25.d: प्रत्यनक्ति । अत्याक्रम्याश्राव्याह । इन्द्रं यज । इति "महेन्द्रम्" इति वा यदि महेन्द्रयाजी भवति
1.17.25.m: He anoints it in return. Having stepped across, having made the call, he says, 'Worship Indra,' or 'Mahendra' if he is a sacrificer to Mahendra.

1.17.25.s: vaṣaṭkṛte juhoti | athopastīrya dakṣiṇasya puroḍāśasyottarārdhād avadyann āha | agnaye sviṣṭakṛte 'nubrūhi | iti
1.17.25.d: वषट्कृते जुहोति । अथोपस्तीर्य दक्षिणस्य पुरोडाशस्योत्तरार्धाद् अवद्यन्न् आह । अग्नये स्विष्टकृते ऽनुब्रूहि । इति
1.17.25.m: When the vaṣaṭ call has been made, he pours the offering. Then, having made an underlayer, cutting a portion from the northern half of the southern cake, he says, 'Recite for Agni Sviṣṭakṛt.'

1.17.25.s: sakṛd dakṣiṇasya puroḍāśasyottarārdhād avadyati sakṛd dhruvājyāt sakṛd uttarasya puroḍāśasya sakṛc chṛtasya sakṛd dadhnas |
1.17.25.d: सकृद् दक्षिणस्य पुरोडाशस्योत्तरार्धाद् अवद्यति सकृद् ध्रुवाज्यात् सकृद् उत्तरस्य पुरोडाशस्य सकृच् छृतस्य सकृद् दध्नस् ।
1.17.25.m: He cuts a portion once from the northern half of the southern cake, once from the ghee of the dhruvā ladle, once from the northern cake, once from the boiled [milk], once from the curd.
He sprinkles [it] twice. He does not anoint it in return.

1.17.25.s: avatte sviṣṭakṛti sruveṇa pārvaṇau homau juhoti | ṛṣabhaṃ vājinaṃ vayaṃ pūrṇamāsaṃ yajāmahe | sa no dohatām̐ suvīryam̐ rāyaspoṣam̐ sahasriṇam | prāṇāya surādhase pūrṇamāsāya svāhā | iti paurṇamāsyām
1.17.25.d: अवत्ते स्विष्टकृति स्रुवेण पार्वणौ होमौ जुहोति । ऋषभं वाजिनं वयं पूर्णमासं यजामहे । स नो दोहताँ सुवीर्यँ रायस्पोषँ सहस्रिणम् । प्राणाय सुराधसे पूर्णमासाय स्वाहा । इति पौर्णमास्याम्
1.17.25.m: When the sviṣṭakṛt portion has been cut, he pours the two seasonal offerings with the dipping-spoon, [with]: 'We worship the bull, the vigorous full-moon day; / may it milk for us good virility, thousandfold thriving of wealth. / To the out-breath, to the bountiful full-moon day, svāhā!' at the full moon ritual;

1.17.26.s: amāvāsyā subhagā suśevā dhenur iva bhūya āpyāyamānā | sā no dohatām̐ suvīryam̐ rāyaspoṣam̐ sahasriṇam | apānāya surādhase 'māvāsyāyai svāhā | ity amāvāsyāyām
1.17.26.d: अमावास्या सुभगा सुशेवा धेनुर् इव भूय आप्यायमाना । सा नो दोहताँ सुवीर्यँ रायस्पोषँ सहस्रिणम् । अपानाय सुराधसे ऽमावास्यायै स्वाहा । इत्य् अमावास्यायाम्
1.17.26.m: [and with]: 'The fortunate, very gracious new-moon day, swelling like a cow again and again; / may it milk for us good virility, thousandfold thriving of wealth. / To the in-breath, to the bountiful new-moon day, svāhā!' at the new moon ritual.
Having stepped across, having made the call, he says, 'Worship Agni Sviṣṭakṛt.'

1.17.26.d: वषट्कृत उत्तरार्धपूर्वार्धे ऽतिहाय पूर्वा आहुतीर् जुहोति ।
1.17.26.m: When the vaṣaṭ call has been made, passing beyond the earlier offerings, he pours the offering in the northeastern quarter.

1.17.26.d: अत्रैतन् मेक्षणम् आहवनीये ऽनुप्रहरति । अथैनत् सँस्रावेणाभिजुहोति ।
1.17.26.m: At this point he throws the stirring-stick into the āhavanīya fire. Then he pours an offering over it with the trickle [of ghee].

1.17.26.s: athodaṅṅ atyākramya juhvām apa ānīya saṃkṣālanam antaḥparidhi ninayati vaiśvānare havir idaṃ juhomi sāhasram utsam̐ śatadhāram etam | sa naḥ pitaraṃ pitāmahaṃ prapitāmaham̐ suvarge loke gacchatu pinvamānam̐ svadhā namas | iti
1.17.26.d: अथोदङ्ङ् अत्याक्रम्य जुह्वाम् अप आनीय संक्षालनम् अन्तःपरिधि निनयति वैश्वानरे हविर् इदं जुहोमि साहस्रम् उत्सँ शतधारम् एतम् । स नः पितरं पितामहं प्रपितामहँ सुवर्गे लोके गच्छतु पिन्वमानँ स्वधा नमस् । इति
1.17.26.m: Then, having stepped across to the north, having brought water into the juhū ladle, he pours out the washings inside the enclosing sticks with: 'I offer this oblation into Vaiśvānara, this thousandfold, hundred-streamed wellspring; / swelling, may it go to our father, grandfather, and great-grandfather in the heavenly world; svadhā! homage!'

1.17.26.s: nirṇijya srucaṃ niṣṭapyādbhiḥ pūrayitvā bahiḥparidhi ninayati | imam̐ samudram̐ śatadhāram utsaṃ vyacyamānaṃ bhuvanasya madhye | ghṛtaṃ duhānām aditiṃ janāyāgne mā him̐sīḥ parame vyoman | iti |
1.17.26.d: निर्णिज्य स्रुचं निष्टप्याद्भिः पूरयित्वा बहिःपरिधि निनयति । इमँ समुद्रँ शतधारम् उत्सं व्यच्यमानं भुवनस्य मध्ये । घृतं दुहानाम् अदितिं जनायाग्ने मा हिँसीः परमे व्योमन् । इति ।
1.17.26.m: Having washed the ladle, having heated it, having filled it with water, he pours it out outside the enclosing sticks with: 'This ocean, this hundred-streamed wellspring, opening wide in the midst of the world, / Aditi milking ghee for the people—do not harm it, O Agni, in the highest firmament.'

1.17.26.s: atraitad aupabhṛtam ājyam̐ sarvaśa eva juhvām̐ samānayate |
1.17.26.d: अत्रैतद् औपभृतम् आज्यँ सर्वश एव जुह्वाँ समानयते ।
1.17.26.m: At this point he gathers all the ghee of the upabhṛt ladle into the juhū ladle.

1.17.26.s: atha yathāyatanam̐ srucau sādayitvā prāśitram avadyati dakṣiṇasya puroḍāśasyottarārdhād yavamātram ajyāyo yavamātrāt | āvyādhāt kṛtyatām idam | mā rūrupāma yajñasya śuddham̐ sviṣṭam idam̐ havis | iti |
1.17.26.d: अथ यथायतनँ स्रुचौ सादयित्वा प्राशित्रम् अवद्यति दक्षिणस्य पुरोडाशस्योत्तरार्धाद् यवमात्रम् अज्यायो यवमात्रात् । आव्याधात् कृत्यताम् इदम् । मा रूरुपाम यज्ञस्य शुद्धँ स्विष्टम् इदँ हविस् । इति ।
1.17.26.m: Then, having placed the two ladles in their proper places, he cuts off the prāśitra portion from the northern half of the southern cake, barley-corn-sized—not larger than a barley-corn—with: 'Let this be cut without piercing; may we not injure the sacrifice; pure, well-offered is this oblation.'

1.17.26.s: athainat sruvadaṇḍenābhighārya jaghanena praṇītāḥ sādayitvādbhiḥ sruvadaṇḍam̐ saṃsparśyāvadadhāti ||
1.17.26.d: अथैनत् स्रुवदण्डेनाभिघार्य जघनेन प्रणीताः सादयित्वाद्भिः स्रुवदण्डँ संस्पर्श्यावदधाति ॥
1.17.26.m: Then, having sprinkled it with the handle of the dipping-spoon, having placed it to the west of the praṇītā waters, having touched the handle of the dipping-spoon with water, he puts it down.

1.18.26.s: atha kam̐saṃ vā camasaṃ veḍopahavanaṃ yācati tam antarvedi nidhāya tasminn upastīrya dakṣiṇasya puroḍāśasya dakṣiṇārdhāt prarujyāvadadhāti manunā dṛṣṭāṃ ghṛtapadīṃ mitrāvaruṇasamīritām | dakṣiṇārdhād asaṃbhindann avadyāmy ekatomukhām iti
1.18.26.d: अथ कँसं वा चमसं वेडोपहवनं याचति तम् अन्तर्वेदि निधाय तस्मिन्न् उपस्तीर्य दक्षिणस्य पुरोडाशस्य दक्षिणार्धात् प्ररुज्यावदधाति मनुना दृष्टां घृतपदीं मित्रावरुणसमीरिताम् । दक्षिणार्धाद् असंभिन्दन्न् अवद्याम्य् एकतोमुखाम् इति
1.18.26.m: Then he asks for a bronze cup or a wooden goblet for inviting the iḍā. Having placed it within the altar, having made an underlayer in it, having broken off [a piece] from the southern half of the southern cake, he places it [in the cup] with: 'Seen by Manu, ghee-footed, impelled by Mitra and Varuṇa, / not splitting [it], I cut from the southern half that which faces in one direction.'

1.18.27.m: Splitting the portions, he places a second [piece in the cup].

1.18.27.s: atha dakṣiṇasyaiva puroḍāśasya pūrvārdhāt tryaṅgulaṃ vā caturaṅgulaṃ vājyena susaṃtṛptam̐ saṃtarpyāgreṇa dhruvāṃ yajamānabhāgaṃ nidadhāti
1.18.27.d: अथ दक्षिणस्यैव पुरोडाशस्य पूर्वार्धात् त्र्यङ्गुलं वा चतुरङ्गुलं वाज्येन सुसंतृप्तँ संतर्प्याग्रेण ध्रुवां यजमानभागं निदधाति
1.18.27.m: Then, from the eastern half of the southern cake itself, having thoroughly satisfied [a piece of] three fingers or four fingers [in width] with ghee, he places the sacrificer's share in front of the dhruvā ladle.

1.18.27.s: dvir dhruvājyādavadyati dvir uttarasya puroḍāśasya dviḥ śṛtasya dvir dadhnas |
1.18.27.d: द्विर् ध्रुवाज्यादवद्यति द्विर् उत्तरस्य पुरोडाशस्य द्विः शृतस्य द्विर् दध्नस् ।
1.18.27.m: He cuts two portions from the ghee of the dhruvā ladle, two from the northern cake, two from the boiled [milk], two from the curd.

1.18.27.s: abhighārayati | atha hotur dvir aṅgulāvanakti nighreṇa bhakṣayitvā
1.18.27.d: अभिघारयति । अथ होतुर् द्विर् अङ्गुलावनक्ति निघ्रेण भक्षयित्वा
1.18.27.m: He sprinkles [them] with ghee. Then he twice anoints two fingers of the hotṛ priest. Having consumed [his portion] by smelling,

1.18.27.s: caturavāntareḍām avadyati | upastṛṇāti dvir ādahāti | abhighārayati
1.18.27.d: चतुरवान्तरेडाम् अवद्यति । उपस्तृणाति द्विर् आदहाति । अभिघारयति
1.18.27.m: he cuts the intermediate iḍā of four portions: he makes an underlayer, he places [the portions] twice, [and] he sprinkles [them].

1.18.27.s: samanvārabhante 'dhvaryuś ca yajamānaś ca brahmā cāgnīdhraś ca |
1.18.27.d: समन्वारभन्ते ऽध्वर्युश् च यजमानश् च ब्रह्मा चाग्नीध्रश् च ।
1.18.27.m: The adhvaryu priest, the sacrificer, the brahman priest, and the āgnīdhra priest touch along together.

1.18.27.s: atha yatra hotur abhijānāti daivyā adhvaryava upahūtā upahūtā manuṣyās | iti tad dakṣiṇaṃ puroḍāśaṃ caturdhā kṛtvā barhiṣadaṃ karoti |
1.18.27.d: अथ यत्र होतुर् अभिजानाति दैव्या अध्वर्यव उपहूता उपहूता मनुष्यास् । इति तद् दक्षिणं पुरोडाशं चतुर्धा कृत्वा बर्हिषदं करोति ।
1.18.27.m: Then, when he hears the hotṛ priest [recite]: 'The divine adhvaryu priests have been invoked; invoked are the human,' then, having divided the southern cake into four parts, he places it on the sacrificial grass.

1.18.27.s: atha yatra hotur abhijānāti | upahūto 'yaṃ yajamānas | iti tarhi yajamāno hotāram īkṣamāṇo vāyuṃ manasā dhyāyet | iti |
1.18.27.d: अथ यत्र होतुर् अभिजानाति । उपहूतो ऽयं यजमानस् । इति तर्हि यजमानो होतारम् ईक्षमाणो वायुं मनसा ध्यायेत् । इति ।
1.18.27.m: Then, when he hears the hotṛ priest say: "Invited is this sacrificer," then the sacrificer, looking at the hotṛ priest, should meditate on Vāyu in his mind.
When the iḍā is invited, he places for the āgnīdhra priest a portion cut six times:

1.18.27.s: upastṛṇāty ādadhāty abhighārayaty upastṛṇāty ādadhāty abhighārayati
1.18.27.d: उपस्तृणात्य् आदधात्य् अभिघारयत्य् उपस्तृणात्य् आदधात्य् अभिघारयति
1.18.27.m: he makes an under-layer, places [the cut portions], sprinkles butter over [them], makes an under-layer, places [the cut portions], and sprinkles butter over [them].

1.18.27.s: prāśnanti mārjayante | athāha brahmaṇe prāśitraṃ parihareti
1.18.27.d: प्राश्नन्ति मार्जयन्ते । अथाह ब्रह्मणे प्राशित्रं परिहरेति
1.18.27.m: They eat. They cleanse themselves. Then he says: "Bring round the prāśitra portion to the brahman priest!"

1.18.27.s: pari prāśitram̐ haranti | anv apo 'nu vedena brahmabhāgam
1.18.27.d: परि प्राशित्रँ हरन्ति । अन्व् अपो ऽनु वेदेन ब्रह्मभागम्
1.18.27.m: They bring round the prāśitra portion; after [it] water, and after [that] the broom with the brahman priest's share.

1.18.27.s: athānvāhāryaṃ yācati | udvāsayanty etad dhavir ucchiṣṭam ||
1.18.27.d: अथान्वाहार्यं याचति । उद्वासयन्त्य् एतद् धविर् उच्छिष्टम् ॥
1.18.27.m: Then he asks for the anvāhārya cooked rice. They remove this leftover oblation.

1.19.27.s: atha saṃpraiṣam āha brahman prasthāsyāmaḥ samidham ādhāyāgnīd agnīn sakṛtsakṛt saṃmṛḍḍhi | iti
1.19.27.d: अथ संप्रैषम् आह ब्रह्मन् प्रस्थास्यामः समिधम् आधायाग्नीद् अग्नीन् सकृत्सकृत् संमृड्ढि । इति
1.19.27.m: Then he gives the summons: "O brahman priest, we shall set out. Āgnīdhra priest, having put on a kindling stick, sweep around the fires once each!"
Being impelled, he then puts on this kindling stick in the middle of the āhavanīya fire.

1.19.28.s: athaiṣa āgnīdhro 'sphyair evedhmasaṃnahanaiḥ paridhīn saṃmārṣṭi sakṛn madhyam̐ sakṛd dakṣiṇārdhyam̐ sakṛd uttarārdhyam |
1.19.28.d: अथैष आग्नीध्रो ऽस्फ्यैर् एवेध्मसंनहनैः परिधीन् संमार्ष्टि सकृन् मध्यँ सकृद् दक्षिणार्ध्यँ सकृद् उत्तरार्ध्यम् ।
1.19.28.m: Then this āgnīdhra priest sweeps the enclosing sticks with the cords that bound the kindling wood, rather than with the wooden sword: once the middle one, once the southern one, once the northern one.

1.19.28.s: sakṛd āhavanīyam upavājayati | agne vājajid vājaṃ tvāgne sasṛvām̐saṃ vājaṃ jigivām̐saṃ vājinaṃ vājajitaṃ vājajityāyai saṃmārjmy agnim annādam annādyāya | iti |
1.19.28.d: सकृद् आहवनीयम् उपवाजयति । अग्ने वाजजिद् वाजं त्वाग्ने ससृवाँसं वाजं जिगिवाँसं वाजिनं वाजजितं वाजजित्यायै संमार्ज्म्य् अग्निम् अन्नादम् अन्नाद्याय । इति ।
1.19.28.m: Once he fans the āhavanīya fire [with the words]: "O Agni, winner of booty, running for booty, having won booty, the vigorous winner of booty, I sweep thee, Agni, for winning booty, Agni the eater of food, for eatable food."

1.19.28.s: athaitānīdhmasaṃnahanāny adbhiḥ sam̐sparśyāhavanīye 'nupraharati yo bhūtānām adhipatī rudras tanticaro vṛṣā | paśūn asmākaṃ mā him̐sīr etad astu hutaṃ tava svāhā | iti |
1.19.28.d: अथैतानीध्मसंनहनान्य् अद्भिः सँस्पर्श्याहवनीये ऽनुप्रहरति यो भूतानाम् अधिपती रुद्रस् तन्तिचरो वृषा । पशून् अस्माकं मा हिँसीर् एतद् अस्तु हुतं तव स्वाहा । इति ।
1.19.28.m: Then, having touched these cords that bound the kindling wood with water, he throws [them] into the āhavanīya fire [with the verse]: "Rudra, who is the overlord of beings, roaming along the line, a bull / do not harm our cattle; let this offering be thine, svāhā!"

1.19.28.s: atha juhūpabhṛtāv ādāyātyākramyāśrāvyāha devān yaja | iti
1.19.28.d: अथ जुहूपभृताव् आदायात्याक्रम्याश्राव्याह देवान् यज । इति
1.19.28.m: Then, having taken the juhū and upabhṛt ladles, stepped across, and made the call, he says: "Recite the offering-verse for the gods!"
At the vaṣaṭ call he offers, [saying]: "Recite the offering-verse, recite the offering-verse!"

1.19.28.s: trīn pratīco 'nūyājān yajati prācāntataḥ saṃbhinatti | athodaṅṅ atyākramya yathāyatanam̐ srucau sādayitvā vājavatībhyām̐ srucau vyūhati vājasya mā prasavena | udgrābheṇodagrabhīt | iti
1.19.28.d: त्रीन् प्रतीचो ऽनूयाजान् यजति प्राचान्ततः संभिनत्ति । अथोदङ्ङ् अत्याक्रम्य यथायतनँ स्रुचौ सादयित्वा वाजवतीभ्याँ स्रुचौ व्यूहति वाजस्य मा प्रसवेन । उद्ग्राभेणोदग्रभीत् । इति
1.19.28.m: He offers three after-offerings moving backward; at the end he pierces them forward. Then, stepping across to the north, having set the two ladles down each in its proper place, he separates the two ladles with the two verses containing the word 'booty': "By the impulse of booty me...", "With the lifting up he has lifted up..."
With the right hand he lifts up the juhū ladle.

1.19.28.s: athā sapatnām̐ indro me nigrābheṇādharām̐ akar iti savyenopabhṛtaṃ nigṛhṇāti |
1.19.28.d: अथा सपत्नाँ इन्द्रो मे निग्राभेणाधराँ अकर् इति सव्येनोपभृतं निगृह्णाति ।
1.19.28.m: "Now Indra has made my rivals below by holding down," saying thus, with the left hand he holds down the upabhṛt ladle.

1.19.28.s: udgrābhaṃ ca nigrābhaṃ ca brahma devā avīvṛdhan | iti prācīṃ juhūm ūhati |
1.19.28.d: उद्ग्राभं च निग्राभं च ब्रह्म देवा अवीवृधन् । इति प्राचीं जुहूम् ऊहति ।
1.19.28.m: "The lifting up and the holding down, the sacred word, the gods have magnified," saying thus, he pushes the juhū ladle forward.

1.19.28.s: athā sapatnān indrāgnī me viṣūcīnān vyasyatām iti pratīcīm upabhṛtaṃ pratyūhati
1.19.28.d: अथा सपत्नान् इन्द्राग्नी मे विषूचीनान् व्यस्यताम् इति प्रतीचीम् उपभृतं प्रत्यूहति
1.19.28.m: "Now let Indra and Agni cast my rivals dispersed on all sides," saying thus, he pulls the upabhṛt ladle back westward.

1.19.28.s: prācyā paridhīn anakti vasubhyas tvā | iti madhyamam | rudrebhyas tvā | iti dakṣiṇam ādityebhyas tvā | ity uttaram
1.19.28.d: प्राच्या परिधीन् अनक्ति वसुभ्यस् त्वा । इति मध्यमम् । रुद्रेभ्यस् त्वा । इति दक्षिणम् आदित्येभ्यस् त्वा । इत्य् उत्तरम्
1.19.28.m: With the [juhū ladle turned] east, he anoints the enclosing sticks: "To the Vasus thee!"—the middle one; "To the Rudras thee!"—the southern one; "To the Ādityas thee!"—the northern one.

1.19.28.s: athopabhṛtam adbhiḥ sam̐sparśya yayāyatanam̐ srucau sādayitvā srukṣu prastaram anakti |
1.19.28.d: अथोपभृतम् अद्भिः सँस्पर्श्य ययायतनँ स्रुचौ सादयित्वा स्रुक्षु प्रस्तरम् अनक्ति ।
1.19.28.m: Then, having touched the upabhṛt ladle with water and set down the two ladles each in its proper place, he anoints the grass bundle in the ladles:

1.19.28.s: aktam̐ rihāṇās | iti juhvām agrāṇi viyantu vayas | ity upabhṛti madhyāni prajāṃ yoniṃ mā nirmṛkṣam iti dhruvāyāṃ mūlāni |
1.19.28.d: अक्तँ रिहाणास् । इति जुह्वाम् अग्राणि वियन्तु वयस् । इत्य् उपभृति मध्यानि प्रजां योनिं मा निर्मृक्षम् इति ध्रुवायां मूलानि ।
1.19.28.m: [saying]: "Licking the anointed..."—the tips in the juhū ladle; "Let the birds fly apart..."—the middles in the upabhṛt ladle; "May I not wipe away offspring and womb!"—the roots in the dhruvā ladle.

1.19.28.s: atha prastarāt tṛṇaṃ pracchidya juhvām avadadhāti |
1.19.28.d: अथ प्रस्तरात् तृणं प्रच्छिद्य जुह्वाम् अवदधाति ।
1.19.28.m: Then, having cut off a blade of grass from the grass bundle, he places it into the juhū ladle.

1.19.29.s: athāśrāvayati | o śrāvaya | astu śrauṣaṭ | iṣitā daivyāhotāro bhadravācyāya preṣito mānuṣaḥ sūktavākāya sūktā brūhi | iti
1.19.29.d: अथाश्रावयति । ओ श्रावय । अस्तु श्रौषट् । इषिता दैव्याहोतारो भद्रवाच्याय प्रेषितो मानुषः सूक्तवाकाय सूक्ता ब्रूहि । इति
1.19.29.m: Then he makes the call: "O cause [him] to hear!", "Let there be śrauṣaṭ!", "The divine hotṛ priests are impelled for the utterance of blessings; the human [hotṛ priest] is impelled for the recitation of the good words; speak the good words!"

1.19.29.s: tam uparīva prāñcaṃ praharati nātyagraṃ praharati na purastāt pratyasyati na pratiśṛṇāti na viṣvañcaṃ viyauty ūrdhvam udyauti | āpyāyantām āpa oṣadhayas | marutāṃ pṛṣataya stha divaṃ gaccha tato no vṛṣṭim eraya | iti |
1.19.29.d: तम् उपरीव प्राञ्चं प्रहरति नात्यग्रं प्रहरति न पुरस्तात् प्रत्यस्यति न प्रतिशृणाति न विष्वञ्चं वियौत्य् ऊर्ध्वम् उद्यौति । आप्यायन्ताम् आप ओषधयस् । मरुतां पृषतय स्थ दिवं गच्छ ततो नो वृष्टिम् एरय । इति ।
1.19.29.m: He throws it forward, as it were upwards; he does not throw it too far forward, he does not cast it backward from the front, he does not break it, he does not scatter it abroad; he lifts it straight up [with the words]: "May the waters and plants swell!", "Ye are the spotted deer of the Maruts!", "Go to heaven, and from there send us rain!"

1.19.29.s: athāgnīdhram īkṣate 'gnīd iti tam āhāgnīdhraḥ saṃvadasva | iti |
1.19.29.d: अथाग्नीध्रम् ईक्षते ऽग्नीद् इति तम् आहाग्नीध्रः संवदस्व । इति ।
1.19.29.m: Then he looks at the āgnīdhra priest: "O Āgnīdhra!" The āgnīdhra priest says to him: "Converse!"

1.19.29.s: agān agnīdh | ity āhādhvaryus | agan ity āhāgnīdhraḥ śrāvaya | ity āhādhvaryuḥ
1.19.29.d: अगान् अग्नीध् । इत्य् आहाध्वर्युस् । अगन् इत्य् आहाग्नीध्रः श्रावय । इत्य् आहाध्वर्युः
1.19.29.m: "Has it gone, Āgnīdh?" says the adhvaryu priest. "It has gone," says the āgnīdhra priest. "Make the call!" says the adhvaryu priest.

1.19.29.s: śrauṣaṭ | ity āhāgnīdhras | idaṃ brūhi | ity āhādhvaryus | anuprahara | ity āhāgnīdhras |
1.19.29.d: श्रौषट् । इत्य् आहाग्नीध्रस् । इदं ब्रूहि । इत्य् आहाध्वर्युस् । अनुप्रहर । इत्य् आहाग्नीध्रस् ।
1.19.29.m: "Śrauṣaṭ!" says the āgnīdhra priest. "Say this!" says the adhvaryu priest. "Throw [it] after!" says the āgnīdhra priest.

1.19.29.s: anupraharati svagā daivyā hotṛbhyaḥ svastir mānuṣebhyaḥ śaṃyor brūhi | iti |
1.19.29.d: अनुप्रहरति स्वगा दैव्या होतृभ्यः स्वस्तिर् मानुषेभ्यः शंयोर् ब्रूहि । इति ।
1.19.29.m: He throws [it] after [with the words]: "Hail to the divine hotṛ priests, well-being to the human ones! Pronounce the blessing!"

1.19.29.s: athopotthāyāhavanīyam upatiṣṭhate | āyuṣpā agne 'sy āyur me pāhi | cakṣuṣpā agne 'si cakṣur me pāhi | iti |
1.19.29.d: अथोपोत्थायाहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठते । आयुष्पा अग्ने ऽस्य् आयुर् मे पाहि । चक्षुष्पा अग्ने ऽसि चक्षुर् मे पाहि । इति ।
1.19.29.m: Then, having risen, he attends upon the āhavanīya fire [with the words]: "Thou art the protector of life, O Agni, protect my life! Thou art the protector of sight, O Agni, protect my sight!"
Then he touches this [earth, saying]: "Firm art thou."

1.19.29.s: madhyamaṃ paridhim anupraharati yaṃ paridhiṃ paryadhatthā agne deva paṇibhir vīyamāṇaḥ | taṃ ta etam anu joṣaṃ bharāmi ned eṣa tvad apacetayātai | iti |
1.19.29.d: मध्यमं परिधिम् अनुप्रहरति यं परिधिं पर्यधत्था अग्ने देव पणिभिर् वीयमाणः । तं त एतम् अनु जोषं भरामि नेद् एष त्वद् अपचेतयातै । इति ।
1.19.29.m: He throws the middle enclosing stick into the fire [with the verse]: "The enclosing stick that thou didst set round thyself, O divine Agni, being pursued by the Paṇis / that I bring to thee according to thy pleasure; let not this [fuel] be missing from thee!"

1.19.29.s: athetarāv upasamasyati yajñasya pātha upa samitam iti |
1.19.29.d: अथेतराव् उपसमस्यति यज्ञस्य पाथ उप समितम् इति ।
1.19.29.m: Then he gathers the other two together [and throws them in with the words]: "Ye have met together with the path of the sacrifice."

1.19.29.s: athainān sam̐srāveṇābhijuhoti juhvām upabhṛtam̐ saṃprasrāvayati sam̐srāvabhāgā stheṣā bṛhantaḥ prastareṣṭhā barhiṣadaś ca devā imāṃ vācam abhi viśve gṛṇanta āsadyāsmin barhiṣi mādayadhvam̐ svāhā | iti |
1.19.29.d: अथैनान् सँस्रावेणाभिजुहोति जुह्वाम् उपभृतँ संप्रस्रावयति सँस्रावभागा स्थेषा बृहन्तः प्रस्तरेष्ठा बर्हिषदश् च देवा इमां वाचम् अभि विश्वे गृणन्त आसद्यास्मिन् बर्हिषि मादयध्वँ स्वाहा । इति ।
1.19.29.m: Then he makes an offering over them with the remnants of the butter. He pours together into the juhū ladle [what was] in the upabhṛt ladle [saying]: "Ye are the shares of the poured-together [butter], mighty, standing on the grass bundle, and seated on the sacrificial grass, O gods; all of you, applauding this speech, sit down on this sacrificial grass and rejoice, svāhā!"

1.19.29.s: atha pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya pratyaṅṅ ādrutya dhuri srucau vimuñcati | agner vām apannagṛhasya sadasi sādayāmi sumnāya sumninī sumne mā dhattam | dhuri dhuryau pātam iti
1.19.29.d: अथ प्रदक्षिणम् आवृत्य प्रत्यङ्ङ् आद्रुत्य धुरि स्रुचौ विमुञ्चति । अग्नेर् वाम् अपन्नगृहस्य सदसि सादयामि सुम्नाय सुम्निनी सुम्ने मा धत्तम् । धुरि धुर्यौ पातम् इति
1.19.29.m: Then, turning clockwise and running westward, he unyokes the two ladles at the pole [with the words]: "In the seat of Agni of fallen home do I place you two; gracious ones, set me in favor for favor; at the pole, protect the two pole-bearers!"

1.19.29.s: yady u vai nāno bhavaty utkara evaine sphye vimuñcaty etenaiva mantreṇa ||
1.19.29.d: यद्य् उ वै नानो भवत्य् उत्कर एवैने स्फ्ये विमुञ्चत्य् एतेनैव मन्त्रेण ॥
1.19.29.m: If, however, there is no cart, he unyokes them on the wooden sword right on the heap of rubbish with this very same mantra.

1.20.30.s: athādatte dakṣiṇenājyasthālīm̐ sasruvām̐ savyena juhūṃ hotre vedaṃ pradāya
1.20.30.d: अथादत्ते दक्षिणेनाज्यस्थालीँ सस्रुवाँ सव्येन जुहूं होत्रे वेदं प्रदाय
1.20.30.m: Then he takes the vessel of melted butter with the spoon in his right hand and the juhū ladle in his left, having handed over the broom to the hotṛ priest.

1.20.30.s: pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya pratyañcāv ādravatas | dakṣiṇenādhvaryur gārhapatyaṃ parikrāmaty uttareṇa hotā
1.20.30.d: प्रदक्षिणम् आवृत्य प्रत्यञ्चाव् आद्रवतस् । दक्षिणेनाध्वर्युर् गार्हपत्यं परिक्रामत्य् उत्तरेण होता
1.20.30.m: Having turned clockwise, they two run westward. The adhvaryu priest walks around south of the gārhapatya fire, the hotṛ priest north.

1.20.30.s: tau jaghanena gārhapatyaṃ paścāt prāñcāv upaviśato dakṣiṇa evādhvaryur uttaro hotā |
1.20.30.d: तौ जघनेन गार्हपत्यं पश्चात् प्राञ्चाव् उपविशतो दक्षिण एवाध्वर्युर् उत्तरो होता ।
1.20.30.m: The two sit down west behind the gārhapatya fire facing eastward, the adhvaryu priest on the right, the hotṛ priest on the left.

1.20.30.s: athādhvaryur vedam upabhṛtaṃ kṛtvā catura ājyasya gṛhṇāna āha "somāya" | ity upām̐śu | "anubrūhi" | ity uccais |
1.20.30.d: अथाध्वर्युर् वेदम् उपभृतं कृत्वा चतुर आज्यस्य गृह्णान आह "सोमाय" । इत्य् उपाँशु । "अनुब्रूहि" । इत्य् उच्चैस् ।
1.20.30.m: Then the adhvaryu priest, having made the broom an upabhṛt ladle, taking four [portions] of melted butter, says in a whisper: "To Soma", [and] aloud: "Recite the invitatory verse!"

1.20.30.s: āśrāvyāha "somam" ity upām̐śu "yaja" | ity uccais | vaṣaṭkṛte juhoti
1.20.30.d: आश्राव्याह "सोमम्" इत्य् उपाँशु "यज" । इत्य् उच्चैस् । वषट्कृते जुहोति
1.20.30.m: Having made the call, he says in a whisper: "For Soma", [and] aloud: "Recite the offering-verse!" At the vaṣaṭ call he offers.

1.20.30.s: catura evājyasya gṛhṇāna āha "tvaṣṭre" | ity upām̐śu | "anubrūhi" | ity uccais | āśrāvyāha "tvaṣṭāram" ity upām̐śu "yaja" | ity uccais |
1.20.30.d: चतुर एवाज्यस्य गृह्णान आह "त्वष्ट्रे" । इत्य् उपाँशु । "अनुब्रूहि" । इत्य् उच्चैस् । आश्राव्याह "त्वष्टारम्" इत्य् उपाँशु "यज" । इत्य् उच्चैस् ।
1.20.30.m: Taking just four [portions] of melted butter, he says in a whisper: "To Tvaṣṭṛ", [and] aloud: "Recite the invitatory verse!" Having made the call, he says in a whisper: "For Tvaṣṭṛ", [and] aloud: "Recite the offering-verse!"

1.20.30.s: vaṣaṭkṛte juhoti catura evājyasya gṛhṇāna āha "devānāṃ patnībhyas" | ity upām̐śu | "anubrūhi" | ity uccais |
1.20.30.d: वषट्कृते जुहोति चतुर एवाज्यस्य गृह्णान आह "देवानां पत्नीभ्यस्" । इत्य् उपाँशु । "अनुब्रूहि" । इत्य् उच्चैस् ।
1.20.30.m: At the vaṣaṭ call he offers. Taking just four [portions] of melted butter, he says in a whisper: "To the wives of the gods", [and] aloud: "Recite the invitatory verse!"

1.20.30.s: āśrāvyāha "devānāṃ patnīs" | ity upām̐śu "yaja" | ity uccais | vaṣaṭkṛte pariśrite devānāṃ patnīr juhoti |
1.20.30.d: आश्राव्याह "देवानां पत्नीस्" । इत्य् उपाँशु "यज" । इत्य् उच्चैस् । वषट्कृते परिश्रिते देवानां पत्नीर् जुहोति ।
1.20.30.m: Having made the call, he says in a whisper: "For the wives of the gods", [and] aloud: "Recite the offering-verse!" At the vaṣaṭ call, in an enclosed space, he offers to the wives of the gods.

1.20.30.s: atha catura evājyasya gṛhṇāna āha | "agnaye gṛhapataye" | ity upām̐śu | "anubrūhi" | ity uccais |
1.20.30.d: अथ चतुर एवाज्यस्य गृह्णान आह । "अग्नये गृहपतये" । इत्य् उपाँशु । "अनुब्रूहि" । इत्य् उच्चैस् ।
1.20.30.m: Then, taking just four [portions] of melted butter, he says in a whisper: "To Agni, lord of the house", [and] aloud: "Recite the invitatory verse!"

1.20.30.s: āśrāvyāha | "agniṃ gṛhapatim" ity upām̐śu "yaja" | ity uccais |
1.20.30.d: आश्राव्याह । "अग्निं गृहपतिम्" इत्य् उपाँशु "यज" । इत्य् उच्चैस् ।
1.20.30.m: Having made the call, he says in a whisper: "For Agni, lord of the house", [and] aloud: "Recite the offering-verse!"

1.20.30.d: वषट्कृत उत्तरार्धपूर्वार्धे ऽतिहाय पूर्वा आहुतीर् जुहोति ।
1.20.30.m: At the vaṣaṭ call, passing beyond the earlier offerings, he offers in the north-eastern part.

1.20.30.s: athāgreṇa hotāram upātītya hotur dvir aṅgulāv anakti
1.20.30.d: अथाग्रेण होतारम् उपातीत्य होतुर् द्विर् अङ्गुलाव् अनक्ति
1.20.30.m: Then, having passed around the hotṛ priest by the front, he anoints two fingers of the hotṛ priest.

1.20.30.s: nighreṇa bhakṣayitvā caturhasteḍām̐ saṃpādayatyājyasyaiva samanvārabhete adhvaryuś caiva patnī ca |
1.20.30.d: निघ्रेण भक्षयित्वा चतुर्हस्तेडाँ संपादयत्याज्यस्यैव समन्वारभेते अध्वर्युश् चैव पत्नी च ।
1.20.30.m: Having consumed [his portion] by smelling, he prepares the four-handed iḍā of the clarified butter itself. Both the adhvaryu priest and the wife take hold from behind.
When the iḍā has been invoked, he places the sixfold-cut portion for the Āgnīdhra.

1.20.30.s: prāśnītas | mārjayete atha sruci caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvāpasalaiḥ paryāvṛtyānvāhāryapacane prāyaścittaṃ juhoti | ulūkhale musale yac ca śūrpe | āśiśleṣa dṛṣadi kṛṣṇājine yat kapāle | avapruṣo vipruṣaḥ saṃyajāmi viśve devā havir idaṃ juṣantām | yajñe yā vipruṣaḥ santi bahvīs | agnau tāḥ sarvāḥ sviṣṭāḥ sahutā juhomi svāhā | iti |
1.20.30.d: प्राश्नीतस् । मार्जयेते अथ स्रुचि चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वापसलैः पर्यावृत्यान्वाहार्यपचने प्रायश्चित्तं जुहोति । उलूखले मुसले यच् च शूर्पे । आशिश्लेष दृषदि कृष्णाजिने यत् कपाले । अवप्रुषो विप्रुषः संयजामि विश्वे देवा हविर् इदं जुषन्ताम् । यज्ञे या विप्रुषः सन्ति बह्वीस् । अग्नौ ताः सर्वाः स्विष्टाः सहुता जुहोमि स्वाहा । इति ।
1.20.30.m: They both eat. They purify themselves. Then, having taken four ladlings in the ladle, having turned around counter-clockwise, he offers the expiation on the anvāhāryapacana fire with: "Whatever [remains] in the mortar, in the pestle, and on the winnowing basket, / whatever stuck to the millstone, to the black antelope skin, [or] on the potsherd, / I offer together the droppings, the scattered drops; / let the All-Gods partake of this havis! / The many drops that are in the sacrifice, / all of them I offer well-offered, offered together in the fire, svāhā!"

1.20.31.s: aparaṃ caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvānvāhāryapacana evedhmapravraścanāny abhyādhāya phalīkaraṇān opya phalīkaraṇahomaṃ juhoti | agne 'dabdhāyo 'śītatano pāhi mādya divaḥ pāhi prasityai pāhi duriṣṭyai pāhi duradmanyai pāhi duścaritāt | aviṣaṃ naḥ pituṃ kṛṇu suṣadā yonim̐ svāhā | iti |
1.20.31.d: अपरं चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वान्वाहार्यपचन एवेध्मप्रव्रश्चनान्य् अभ्याधाय फलीकरणान् ओप्य फलीकरणहोमं जुहोति । अग्ने ऽदब्धायो ऽशीततनो पाहि माद्य दिवः पाहि प्रसित्यै पाहि दुरिष्ट्यै पाहि दुरद्मन्यै पाहि दुश्चरितात् । अविषं नः पितुं कृणु सुषदा योनिँ स्वाहा । इति ।
1.20.31.m: Taking another four ladlings, having placed the wood-chips on that very anvāhāryapacana fire, and having strewn the chaff, he offers the chaff-offering with: "O Fire of unbreathed-upon metal, of unwarmed body, protect me today from the sky, protect from bondage, protect from bad sacrifice, protect from bad food, protect from evil conduct! / Make our food free of poison, / the womb easy to sit in, svāhā!"

1.20.31.s: athaitenaiva yathetam etya vede yajamānaṃ vācayati vedo 'si vittir asi | ity āntādanuvākasya hotre vedaṃ pradāya patnīṃ viṣyati | imaṃ viṣyāmi varuṇasya pāśaṃ yam abadhnīta savitā suketaḥ | dhātuś ca yonau sukṛtasya loke syonaṃ me saha patyā karomi | iti |
1.20.31.d: अथैतेनैव यथेतम् एत्य वेदे यजमानं वाचयति वेदो ऽसि वित्तिर् असि । इत्य् आन्तादनुवाकस्य होत्रे वेदं प्रदाय पत्नीं विष्यति । इमं विष्यामि वरुणस्य पाशं यम् अबध्नीत सविता सुकेतः । धातुश् च योनौ सुकृतस्य लोके स्योनं मे सह पत्या करोमि । इति ।
1.20.31.m: Then, having returned by the very way he had gone, [he causes the sacrificer to recite over the broom: "You are the veda, you are the acquisition…" up to the end of the anuvāka,] having handed over the broom to the hotṛ priest, he unties the wife with: "I untie this cord of Varuṇa, which Savitar the good-minded tied; / and in the womb of the creator, in the world of the well-done, I make it pleasant for myself together with my husband."

1.20.31.s: athāsyai yoktram añjalāv ādhāyodapātram ānayati sam āyuṣā saṃ prajayā sam agne varcasā punaḥ | saṃ patnī patyāhaṃ gacche sam ātmā tanuvā mama | iti |
1.20.31.d: अथास्यै योक्त्रम् अञ्जलाव् आधायोदपात्रम् आनयति सम् आयुषा सं प्रजया सम् अग्ने वर्चसा पुनः । सं पत्नी पत्याहं गच्छे सम् आत्मा तनुवा मम । इति ।
1.20.31.m: Then, having placed the girdle in her hollowed hands, he brings the water-vessel with: "Together with life, together with offspring, together again, O Fire, with brilliance! / May I, the wife, unite with my husband, may my soul unite with my body!"

1.20.31.s: atha mukhaṃ vimṛṣṭe yad apsu te sarasvati goṣv aśveṣu yan madhu | tena me vājinīvati mukham aṅdhi sarasvati | iti |
1.20.31.d: अथ मुखं विमृष्टे यद् अप्सु ते सरस्वति गोष्व् अश्वेषु यन् मधु । तेन मे वाजिनीवति मुखम् अङ्धि सरस्वति । इति ।
1.20.31.m: Then she wipes her face with: "What sweetness of yours, O Sarasvatī, is in the waters, in cows, in horses, / with that, O rich in mares, Sarasvatī, anoint my face!"

1.20.31.s: apo ninayati | avabhṛthasyaiva rūpaṃ kṛtvottiṣṭhati | iti brāhmaṇam ||
1.20.31.d: अपो निनयति । अवभृथस्यैव रूपं कृत्वोत्तिष्ठति । इति ब्राह्मणम् ॥
1.20.31.m: He pours out the water. "Having made the form of the final bath itself, she stands up," says the brāhmaṇa passage.

1.21.31.s: athaināṃ tathaiva tiraḥ pavitram apa ācāmayati payasvatīr oṣadhayaḥ payasvad vīrudhāṃ payaḥ | apāṃ payaso yat payas tena mām indra sam̐sṛja | iti |
1.21.31.d: अथैनां तथैव तिरः पवित्रम् अप आचामयति पयस्वतीर् ओषधयः पयस्वद् वीरुधां पयः । अपां पयसो यत् पयस् तेन माम् इन्द्र सँसृज । इति ।
1.21.31.m: Then, in the same way, he makes her sip water across the purifier with: "Rich in milk are the plants, rich in milk is the sap of the climbing plants; / with the sap of waters which is milk, unite me, O Indra!"

1.21.32.s: athaināṃ gārhapatye samidha ādhāpayati | agne vratapate vratam acāriṣam | tad aśakam | tan me 'rādhi svāhā vāyo vratapata āditya vratapate vratānāṃ vratapate vratam acāriṣam | tad aśakam | tan me 'rādhi svāhā | iti |
1.21.32.d: अथैनां गार्हपत्ये समिध आधापयति । अग्ने व्रतपते व्रतम् अचारिषम् । तद् अशकम् । तन् मे ऽराधि स्वाहा वायो व्रतपत आदित्य व्रतपते व्रतानां व्रतपते व्रतम् अचारिषम् । तद् अशकम् । तन् मे ऽराधि स्वाहा । इति ।
1.21.32.m: Then he makes her place kindling sticks on the gārhapatya fire with: "O Fire, lord of vows, I have kept the vow! / I was able to do it! / It has succeeded for me, svāhā! O Vāyu, lord of vows! O Āditya, lord of vows! O lord of the vows of vows, I have kept the vow! / I was able to do it! / It has succeeded for me, svāhā!"

1.21.32.s: atha yathāprapannaṃ niṣkrāmayati | atha prāṅ etya dhruvām āpyāyayati | āpyāyatāṃ dhruvā ghṛtena yajñaṃyajñaṃ prati devayadbhyaḥ | sūryāyā ūdho 'dityā upastha urudhārā pṛthivī yajñe asmin | iti |
1.21.32.d: अथ यथाप्रपन्नं निष्क्रामयति । अथ प्राङ् एत्य ध्रुवाम् आप्याययति । आप्यायतां ध्रुवा घृतेन यज्ञंयज्ञं प्रति देवयद्भ्यः । सूर्याया ऊधो ऽदित्या उपस्थ उरुधारा पृथिवी यज्ञे अस्मिन् । इति ।
1.21.32.m: Then he makes her exit the way she had entered. Then, having stepped eastward, he replenishes the dhruvā ladle with: "May the dhruvā swell with clarified butter at each sacrifice for those who seek the gods, / the udder of Sūryā, the lap of Aditi, the wide-flowing earth at this sacrifice."

1.21.32.s: athājyasthālyāḥ sruveṇopaghātaṃ prāyaścittāni juhoti | āśrāvitam atyāśrāvitam | vaṣaṭkṛtam atyanūktaṃ ca yajñe | atiriktaṃ karmaṇo yac ca hīnam | yajñaḥ parvāṇi pratiranneti kalpayan | svāhākṛtāhutir etu devānt svāhā | iti |
1.21.32.d: अथाज्यस्थाल्याः स्रुवेणोपघातं प्रायश्चित्तानि जुहोति । आश्रावितम् अत्याश्रावितम् । वषट्कृतम् अत्यनूक्तं च यज्ञे । अतिरिक्तं कर्मणो यच् च हीनम् । यज्ञः पर्वाणि प्रतिरन्नेति कल्पयन् । स्वाहाकृताहुतिर् एतु देवान्त् स्वाहा । इति ।
1.21.32.m: Then, taking portions from the butter-pot with the sruva ladle, he offers the expiations with: "What was called, what was over-called, / what was called with vaṣaṭ, and what was over-recited at the sacrifice, / what was redundant of the rite and what was deficient, / may the sacrifice, crossing each joint as it goes, arranging [it], / go as an offering made with svāhā to the gods, svāhā!"

1.21.32.s: atha yajñasamṛddhīr juhoti | iṣṭebhyaḥ svāhā vaṣaḍ aniṣṭebhyaḥ svāhā bheṣajaṃ duriṣṭyai svāhā niṣkṛtyai svāhā daurārddhyai svāhā daivībhyas tanūbhyaḥ svāhā ṛddhyai svāhā samṛddhyai svāhā sarvasamṛddhyai svāhā bhūḥ svāhā bhuvaḥ svāhā suvaḥ svāhā bhūr bhuvaḥ suvaḥ svāhā | imaṃ me varuṇa tat tvā yāmi tvaṃ no agne sa tvaṃ no agne tvam agne ayāsi | ayā san manasā hitaḥ | ayā san havyam ūhiṣe ayā no dhehi bheṣajam̐ svāhā | ayāś cāgne 'sy anabhiśastīś ca satyam it tvam ayā asi | ayasā manasā dhṛtas | ayasā havam ūhiṣe | ayā no dhehi bheṣajam̐ svāhā yad asmin karmaṇy antar agāma mantrataḥ karmato vā | anayāhutyā tac chamayāmi sarvam | tṛpyantu devā āvṛṣantāṃ ghṛtena svāhā yad asya karmaṇo 'tyarīricam | yad vā nyūnam ihākaram | agniṣ ṭat sviṣṭakṛd vidvān sarvam̐ sviṣṭam̐ suhutam karotu me | agnaye sviṣṭakṛte suhutahuta āhutīnāṃ kāmānām̐ samardhayitre svāhā | prajāpate na tvad etāny anyas | viśvā jātāni pari tā babhūva | yatkāmās te juhumas tan no astu vayam̐ syāma patayo rayīṇām̐ svāhā | iti |
1.21.32.d: अथ यज्ञसमृद्धीर् जुहोति । इष्टेभ्यः स्वाहा वषड् अनिष्टेभ्यः स्वाहा भेषजं दुरिष्ट्यै स्वाहा निष्कृत्यै स्वाहा दौरार्द्ध्यै स्वाहा दैवीभ्यस् तनूभ्यः स्वाहा ऋद्ध्यै स्वाहा समृद्ध्यै स्वाहा सर्वसमृद्ध्यै स्वाहा भूः स्वाहा भुवः स्वाहा सुवः स्वाहा भूर् भुवः सुवः स्वाहा । इमं मे वरुण तत् त्वा यामि त्वं नो अग्ने स त्वं नो अग्ने त्वम् अग्ने अयासि । अया सन् मनसा हितः । अया सन् हव्यम् ऊहिषे अया नो धेहि भेषजँ स्वाहा । अयाश् चाग्ने ऽस्य् अनभिशस्तीश् च सत्यम् इत् त्वम् अया असि । अयसा मनसा धृतस् । अयसा हवम् ऊहिषे । अया नो धेहि भेषजँ स्वाहा यद् अस्मिन् कर्मण्य् अन्तर् अगाम मन्त्रतः कर्मतो वा । अनयाहुत्या तच् छमयामि सर्वम् । तृप्यन्तु देवा आवृषन्तां घृतेन स्वाहा यद् अस्य कर्मणो ऽत्यरीरिचम् । यद् वा न्यूनम् इहाकरम् । अग्निष् टत् स्विष्टकृद् विद्वान् सर्वँ स्विष्टँ सुहुतम् करोतु मे । अग्नये स्विष्टकृते सुहुतहुत आहुतीनां कामानाँ समर्धयित्रे स्वाहा । प्रजापते न त्वद् एतान्य् अन्यस् । विश्वा जातानि परि ता बभूव । यत्कामास् ते जुहुमस् तन् नो अस्तु वयँ स्याम पतयो रयीणाँ स्वाहा । इति ।
1.21.32.m: Then he offers the sacrifice-fulfillments with: "To the offered, svāhā! vaṣaṭ to the unoffered, svāhā! Medicine for the ill-sacrificed, svāhā! For reparation, svāhā! For misfortune, svāhā! To the divine bodies, svāhā! For prosperity, svāhā! For full prosperity, svāhā! For all-prosperity, svāhā! Bhūḥ, svāhā! Bhuvaḥ, svāhā! Suvaḥ, svāhā! Bhūr bhuvaḥ suvaḥ, svāhā! 'This of mine, O Varuṇa…' 'To you I go…' 'Do you to us, O Fire…' 'So do you to us, O Fire…' 'You, O Fire, are Ayās; / being Ayās, you are established with the mind; / being Ayās, you have carried the offering; / as Ayās, bestow medicine upon us, svāhā! / And you, O Fire, are Ayās and free from blame; / truly you are Ayās; / supported by an iron-firm mind, / you have conveyed the invocation with iron speed; / as Ayās, bestow medicine upon us, svāhā! What we missed in this rite, / whether in mantra or in action, / with this oblation I appease it all; / let the gods be pleased, let them pour down clarified butter, svāhā! What of this rite I made redundant, / or what I made deficient here, / may Fire Sviṣṭakṛt, knowing, / make it all well-sacrificed, well-offered for me! / To Fire Sviṣṭakṛt, the offerer of what is well offered, the fulfiller of desires of the oblations, svāhā! Prajāpati, none other than you / encompassed all these born beings; / with whatever desires we offer to you, let that be ours; / may we be masters of riches, svāhā!'"

1.21.33.s: atha barhiṣo dhātūnām̐ saṃpralupya dhruvāyām̐ samanakti samaṅktāṃ barhir haviṣā ghṛtena sam ādityair vasubhiḥ saṃ marudbhiḥ | sam indreṇa viśvebhir devebhir aṅktām iti |
1.21.33.d: अथ बर्हिषो धातूनाँ संप्रलुप्य ध्रुवायाँ समनक्ति समङ्क्तां बर्हिर् हविषा घृतेन सम् आदित्यैर् वसुभिः सं मरुद्भिः । सम् इन्द्रेण विश्वेभिर् देवेभिर् अङ्क्ताम् इति ।
1.21.33.m: Then, having pulled out stalks of sacrificial grass, he anoints them in the dhruvā ladle with: "May the barhis be anointed with the havis, with clarified butter, together with the Ādityas, with the Vasus, with the Maruts; / may it be anointed together with Indra, with the All-Gods."

1.21.33.s: athainad āhavanīye 'nupraharati divyaṃ nabho gacchatu yat svāhā | iti |
1.21.33.d: अथैनद् आहवनीये ऽनुप्रहरति दिव्यं नभो गच्छतु यत् स्वाहा । इति ।
1.21.33.m: Then he throws it after into the āhavanīya fire with: "May that which [is offered] go to the heavenly atmosphere, svāhā!"

1.21.33.s: athopotthāya dakṣiṇena padā vedim avakramya dhruvayā samiṣṭayajur juhoti devā gātuvido gātuṃ vittvā gātum ita manasaspata imaṃ no deva deveṣu yajñam̐ svāhā vāci svāhā vāte dhāḥ svāhā | iti |
1.21.33.d: अथोपोत्थाय दक्षिणेन पदा वेदिम् अवक्रम्य ध्रुवया समिष्टयजुर् जुहोति देवा गातुविदो गातुं वित्त्वा गातुम् इत मनसस्पत इमं नो देव देवेषु यज्ञँ स्वाहा वाचि स्वाहा वाते धाः स्वाहा । इति ।
1.21.33.m: Then, having risen and stepped onto the altar with his right foot, he offers the samiṣṭayajus offering with the dhruvā ladle with: "O gods who know the path, having found the path, go on the path! / O lord of mind, divine one, place this sacrifice of ours among the gods, svāhā! in speech, svāhā! in wind, svāhā!"

1.21.33.s: ninayati praṇītās | upotthāya yajamāno dakṣiṇena padā viṣṇukramān kramate
1.21.33.d: निनयति प्रणीतास् । उपोत्थाय यजमानो दक्षिणेन पदा विष्णुक्रमान् क्रमते
1.21.33.m: He pours out the praṇītā waters. Having risen, the sacrificer strides the Viṣṇu-strides with his right foot.

1.21.33.s: saṃtiṣṭhata āmāvāsyaṃ vā paurṇamāsyaṃ vā haviḥ ||
1.21.33.d: संतिष्ठत आमावास्यं वा पौर्णमास्यं वा हविः ॥
1.21.33.m: The new moon oblation or the full moon oblation is concluded.

2.1.34.s: athopavyāharaṇam | vijñāyate kratvādau kratukāmaṃ kāmayīta yajñāṅgādau yajñāṅgakāmam iti
2.1.34.d: अथोपव्याहरणम् । विज्ञायते क्रत्वादौ क्रतुकामं कामयीत यज्ञाङ्गादौ यज्ञाङ्गकामम् इति
2.1.34.m: Now follows the recitation of wishes. It is known [from the sacred texts]: "At the beginning of a sacrifice one should desire the desire of the sacrifice; at the beginning of an ancillary rite of the sacrifice one should desire the desire of the ancillary rite of the sacrifice."

2.1.34.s: prāktūlān darbhān sam̐stīrya teṣu prāṅmukho yajamāna upaviśya japati yāḥ purastāt prasravanty upariṣṭāt sarvataś ca yāḥ | ābhī raśmipavitrābhiḥ śraddhāṃ yajñam ārabhe || devā gātuvido gātuṃ yajñāya vindata | manasaspatinā devena vātād yajñaḥ prayujyatām iti śraddha ehi satyena tvā hvayāmi | iti |
2.1.34.d: प्राक्तूलान् दर्भान् सँस्तीर्य तेषु प्राङ्मुखो यजमान उपविश्य जपति याः पुरस्तात् प्रस्रवन्त्य् उपरिष्टात् सर्वतश् च याः । आभी रश्मिपवित्राभिः श्रद्धां यज्ञम् आरभे ॥ देवा गातुविदो गातुं यज्ञाय विन्दत । मनसस्पतिना देवेन वाताद् यज्ञः प्रयुज्यताम् इति श्रद्ध एहि सत्येन त्वा ह्वयामि । इति ।
2.1.34.m: Having spread out darbha grass with tips pointing east, the sacrificer, sitting upon them facing east, mutters: "Those waters which flow in front, above, and from every side, / with these that are ray-purifiers, I begin faith, the sacrifice. // O gods who know the path, find the path for the sacrifice! / Through the lord of mind, the divine one, let the sacrifice be joined from the wind," and: "O Faith, come! With truth I call you!"
